raw.excerpt: Você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer construir soluções que realmente importam?
raw.description:
Você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e quer construir soluções que realmente importam? Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que há mais de 30 anos é líder global em planejamento inteligente.

Combinamos otimização, análises avançadas, inteligência geoespacial e IA para entregar soluções que transformam cadeias de suprimentos e promovem a sustentabilidade em setores como o florestal e industrial. Nossa tecnologia ajuda empresas a tomar melhores decisões, aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar um crescimento sustentável em um mundo em constante transformação.

Se você quer atuar em um ambiente inovador, colaborativo e com impacto global, essa oportunidade é para você.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

📍 Sobre a vaga

A Remsoft está em busca de um(a) Analista de FP&A para integrar o time. A posição atua em conjunto com as operações do Brasil, Canadá e Austrália, reportando diretamente à liderança financeira no Canadá. É uma função analítica e estratégica: seu foco principal é entender a saúde financeira do negócio através da receita recorrente, projetar crescimento e apoiar decisões de investimento e expansão — não a rotina operacional financeira do dia a dia, que já é conduzida por outras áreas. Você será parceiro(a) estratégico(a) da liderança e do time Comercial e Marketing, traduzindo dados complexos em insights que orientam decisões de negócio.

Este não é um perfil operacional: não fazem parte do escopo desta vaga rotinas como emissão de nota fiscal, contas a pagar/receber, conciliação bancária ou controle contábil, essas atividades já são conduzidas por outras equipes.

🎯 Fará parte do seu dia a dia:

  • Analisar receita recorrente e não recorrente (ARR/MRR), acompanhando churn, downsell e upsell para entender o que está impulsionando ou reduzindo o valor do negócio
  • Compreender e aplicar a lógica de valuation baseada em receita recorrente
  • Trabalhar em parceria estratégica com o time Comercial, entendendo pipeline, prospecção de vendas e traduzindo isso em projeções de receita recorrente e não recorrente
  • Analisar o comportamento da receita por cliente, identificando motivos de alta ou queda no faturamento e o impacto nos resultados da empresa
  • Liderar o ciclo de orçamento anual e as previsões contínuas (rolling forecast), coordenando os insumos das unidades de negócio
  • Construir e manter modelos financeiros multicenário para planejamento, casos de negócio e avaliação de investimentos
  • Apoiar planos financeiros de longo prazo (3 a 5 anos), com projeções de receita, headcount, capex e fluxo de caixa
  • Colaborar com a liderança sênior para modelar cenários estratégicos, como fusões, aquisições, expansão de mercado e reestruturação
  • Monitorar KPI's financeiros e de receita, apresentando recomendações de forma clara para públicos não financeiros
  • Desenvolver dashboards com visibilidade em tempo real sobre desempenho comercial e financeiro
  • Manter fluxos financeiros no Salesforce e garantir a integridade dos dados
  • Colaborar com TI e Operações em melhorias de sistemas, integrações e processos

🎯 Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Finanças, Economia, Contabilidade ou área relacionada
  • 3 ou mais anos de experiência progressiva em FP&A, análise financeira estratégica ou revenue operations — não em rotina financeira operacional
  • 1 ou mais ano de experiência no setor de tecnologia ou software (SaaS), com entendimento prático de métricas de receita recorrente
  • Conhecimento sólido em orçamento, modelagem financeira de longo prazo e análise de variações
  • Vivência analisando receita recorrente, churn e comportamento de carteira de clientes
  • Experiência trabalhando em conjunto com times de Vendas e Marketing
  • Experiência prática com Salesforce, para relatórios de pipeline e comerciais
  • Inglês fluente, escrito e falado, para colaboração com as equipes globais da Remsoft
  • Proficiência avançada em Excel e/ou Google Sheets

Etapa em inglês: o processo seletivo inclui uma entrevista conduzida integralmente em inglês.

💡 Perfil e competências

  • Perfil analítico com viés econômico e estratégico
  • Comunicação clara, com facilidade para traduzir conceitos financeiros complexos para diferentes públicos
  • Curiosidade para investigar o "porquê" por trás dos números, não só reportar o que aconteceu
  • Capacidade de gerenciar prioridades concorrentes e múltiplas entregas simultâneas
  • Perfil colaborativo e orientado a servir o negócio

✔️ Será um plus se você possuir

  • MBA ou certificação CPA/CFA
  • Experiência com NetSuite (ERP/GL)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI, como Power BI, Tableau ou Looker
  • Experiência prévia com múltiplas entidades ou operações internacionais
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a planejamento financeiro, análise de dados ou produtividade, como Microsoft Copilot, Claude AI ou IA integrada a plataformas ERP/CRM

Informações adicionais

🎁 Benefícios que fazem a diferença!

Aqui, valorizamos o seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento profissional! Confira os benefícios que oferecemos para que você tenha mais qualidade de vida e motivação no dia a dia:

💙 Saúde e bem-estar:

✔️ Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico Unimedpara você cuidar da sua saúde com tranquilidade;

✔️Seguro de Vida, porque segurança nunca é demais.

🍽️ Alimentação e qualidade de vida:

✔️ Vale Alimentação no Cartão Swile, para mais liberdade e praticidade na sua escolha;

✔️ Sem desconto do ticket nas férias – você aproveita seu descanso sem impacto no benefício!

💰 Reconhecimento e crescimento:

✔️ Subsídio para Bolsa de Estudos (até 50%), incentivamos seu crescimento acadêmico;

✔️ Subsídio para Certificações (até 100%), para que você se torne um especialista na sua área;

✔️ Programas de Espanhol e Inglês, para expandir suas oportunidades e conexões globais;

✔️ Universidade Corporativa com conteúdos exclusivos para seu desenvolvimento;

✔️ Avaliação de Desempenho 360º, porque acreditamos no crescimento contínuo.

🕒 Flexibilidade e equilíbrio:

✔️ Horário flexível para você organizar sua rotina da melhor forma.

✔️ Day Off no seu aniversário, porque esse dia merece ser especial!

🤝 Cultura colaborativa e valorização do time:

✔️ Cultura de feedback, incentivamos o aprendizado e a melhoria contínua.

Job purpose

The Controller – Corporate Accounting leads BELAY's Corporate Accounting function and is responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of the organization's financial reporting and accounting operations. This role oversees the Corporate Accounting Team, manages the monthly close process, ensures compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), and partners closely with Finance leadership to support budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and strategic decision-making.

The Controller serves as a trusted financial leader, driving operational excellence, strengthening internal controls, and continuously improving accounting processes to support the organization's long-term success.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate Accounting Team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance coaching, and professional development conversations with direct reports.
  • Plan, prioritize, and delegate work assignments while providing technical guidance and removing barriers to team success.
  • Establish and monitor departmental goals, key metrics, and performance expectations.
  • Provide recommendations for process improvements, technology enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Develop and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Partner with the Director of Finance on strategic initiatives and departmental planning.

Financial Reporting & Accounting Operations

  • Oversee the general ledger and ensure accurate recording of income, expenses, and financial transactions.
  • Ensure timely reconciliation of balance sheet accounts and review monthly account reconciliations.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, including maintaining close calendars and reporting deadlines.
  • Monitor working capital accounts, including cash, receivables, payables, accrued liabilities, and fixed assets.
  • Prepare and compile monthly financial statements for leadership and shareholder reporting.
  • Support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc financial analyses.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and BELAY accounting policies.
  • Oversee annual external audits and coordinate audit documentation and support.
  • Maintain the integrity of accounting systems, financial data, and related system integrations.
  • Strengthen internal controls and identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and operational efficiency.

Cash Management & Business Partnership

  • Monitor daily cash position and organizational liquidity.
  • Partner with FP&A to support forecasting, planning, and financial analysis.
  • Provide accounting guidance and technical expertise to operational leaders.
  • Partner with system administrators to implement system enhancements and improve accounting workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7–10+ years of progressive accounting experience with prior leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience managing general ledger accounting, financial reporting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close processes.
  • Strong understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • Experience leading accounting operations and improving financial processes.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to coach, develop, and manage a high-performing team.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of integrity and ability to manage confidential financial information.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and accounting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA designation.
  • Experience leading external audits.
  • Experience with ERP or cloud-based accounting systems.
  • Experience working in a remote or distributed organization.
  • Experience supporting budgeting and financial planning processes.

Skills & Competencies

  • Financial reporting and accounting expertise.
  • Leadership and people development.
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen.
  • Analytical and critical thinking.
  • Process improvement and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Project and time management.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Sound judgment and decision-making.

Working Conditions

BELAY is a remote-first organization. This role requires a dedicated home office, regular use of virtual collaboration tools, and a work schedule that aligns with business needs and BELAY's core collaboration hours. Occasional travel or flexibility outside standard business hours may be required based on the role.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Frequent participation in virtual meetings.
  • Ability to communicate effectively through video conferencing, email, and phone.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Direct Reports

  • Corporate Accountant(s)
  • Accounts Payable Specialist

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

Equal Employment Opportunity

BELAY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Salary range

$87,000 - $92,000

Location requirements

This role is remote within the U.S. However, due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Oregon.

Description

Project Engineer – Renewable Energy and Energy storage systems

An International fast growing Independent Power Producer is looking for an Electrical Engineer with experience in Wind engineering and design. The company specializes in the initiation, development, financing, construction, management, and operation of projects involving the generation of electricity from renewable energy sources (Wind, Solar, Battery Energy Storage). The company has operations in Israel, Europe (western, Northern and eastern Europe) and the US, with a diversified portfolio of income-generating projects, projects during construction and pre-construction that total over 20GW and an additional 30 GWh in different development stages.

Responsibilities

This position may involve a wide variety of diverse assignments including:

  • Project Engineering Management of external and internal stakeholders/consultants/engineering company.
  • Managing and leading RE power plants design criteria for optimization, cost reduction and performance improvement.
  • Responsible for engineering support of Wind Turbine Generator (WTG) projects
  • Perform solar resource assessments and energy production estimates with PVsyst and other optimization tools.
  • Support, from a technical point of view, the procurement phase (request for proposal, contract negotiation, qualification) with OEM, suppliers and BoP/EPC Contractors.
  • Support in the assessment of new opportunities for investment with internal feasibility analysis or with external technical advisors.
  • Collaborate closely with the company business units throughout the project cycle – Business Development, Project Development, Execution.
  • The position will also include exposure to other renewable technologies (such as green Hydrogen).

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous Renewable Energy experience.
  • Previous WTG experience
  • Technical Project Management experience – Advantage
  • Experience in the technical contractual phase for renewable energy Plants
  • Familiarity with Project Development is preferrable
  • Experience in high voltage connections and sub-stations design – Significant advantage
  • Software: WindPro (Advantage), PVsyst, Autocad, Microsoft Office suite, Word and Excel.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills
  • Other skills: Pro-active approach, structured way of working, capacity of managing and integration processes.
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly through formal reports, presentations, teleconferences, memoranda and email.
  • Must be able to function equally well in fast-paced, collaborative, multi-disciplined teams, and self-directed independent assignments.
  • Must be self-motivated, with an ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Requires a degree in electrical engineering.
  • 5 years related work experience. Professionals with less experience may be considered if the profile meets some of the requirements.

Location

  • Europe (remote).
  • The person will mainly support all the initiatives and Projects across Europe.

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

The Group Art Supervisor (GAS) will be responsible for the conception, development, design, and execution of artwork on the team. This includes integrated advertising campaigns, managing the creative process, and ensuring all work is strategically and creatively on point. The GAS leads, guides, and directs the creative design team to ensure all projects are completed on strategy, on time, and within budget. Mentoring junior members of the team is a core requirement, including monitoring projects, delegating assignments, and approving work. Maintaining high standards, understanding and applying design systems, and being committed to consistency and excellence are key qualities.

What you'll do

  • Leads up and down the creative design team, internally and with clients
  • Understands and applies the creative vision for the brand
  • Helps manage junior members of the team and freelancers where appropriate

  • Push creative work and actively share inspiring ideas
  • Fosters positive relationships between creative and other agency functional areas
  • Develop and grow client relationships
  • Shape and guide work
  • Participate in new business pitches

  • Digital portfolio required

  • Bachelor’s degree in advertising, marketing, graphic arts, or equivalent area of study
  • 7 years’ creative/creative management experience
  • Pharmaceutical and/or medical device experience preferred
  • Outstanding creative presentation skills
  • Must be self-motivated, professional, detail-oriented, and possess excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Comfortable working under pressure within tight deadlines
  • Advanced Mac experience with all Adobe Creative Suite and MS Office Suite

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

AI Risk Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Risk Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000 to $150,000 annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an AI Risk Engineer to lead the design and implementation of security controls, threat models, and incident response capabilities specifically tailored to AI and machine learning systems. The role addresses the unique security challenges posed by LLMs, model APIs, training data pipelines, and AI-powered applications, including prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration, and supply chain risks. The ideal candidate has strong security engineering fundamentals and a deep understanding of how modern AI systems work in practice, with hands-on experience designing defenses for both AI-powered applications and the AI infrastructure that supports them.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define and implement security controls specifically targeting LLM and AI-powered application risks.
  • Build threat models for AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and abuse patterns.
  • Design and deploy guardrails, content filters, and policy enforcement layers around model endpoints.
  • Implement runtime detection and response capabilities for adversarial prompts and abusive behavior.
  • Secure training and fine-tuning pipelines, including data provenance, integrity, and access controls.
  • Design controls for sensitive data handling, retention, and redaction in LLM workflows.
  • Lead red-team exercises against AI systems and drive remediation of identified weaknesses.
  • Evaluate and harden third-party AI services and open-source AI components used internally.
  • Implement identity, authorization, and tenant-isolation patterns for multi-tenant AI services.
  • Drive supply chain security for ML artifacts including weights, datasets, and inference dependencies.
  • Collaborate with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet regulatory obligations.
  • Develop monitoring, logging, and detection strategies tailored to AI workloads.
  • Lead incident response for AI-specific security events and drive durable improvements.
  • Stay current with adversarial ML, LLM security research, and emerging regulatory developments.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • Six or more years of security engineering experience, including significant work on AI or ML systems.
  • Strong understanding of LLM internals, modern AI architectures, and common failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience designing security controls for AI-powered applications.

raw.title: Product Designer&Builder for SmartyMe
raw.excerpt: Who we're looking forWe're looking for a product designer who can take a problem from an early, unclear state through to a working prototype, and who builds those prototypes themselves.
raw.description:
Who we're looking for

We're looking for a product designer who can take a problem from an early, unclear state through to a working prototype, and who builds those prototypes themselves.

Three requirements matter most. High ownership, meaning you drive a problem to a result without being managed through it. Product thinking, meaning you can state the customer problem precisely and be specific about what in your solution addresses it and why you expect that to work. And building prototypes yourself, so that something real and testable exists without waiting for engineering. Design craft is assumed. These three are what the role actually depends on.

What the role covers

The role sits on SmartyMe, our mobile educational app, and covers five areas:

  1. Own problems rather than tasks.
    Work usually arrives as a problem, not a detailed spec from a product manager. You'd be responsible for understanding why, deciding what to do, and carrying it through discovery, design, prototype, launch, and measurement.
  2. Product thinking.
    Getting to a precise statement of what the user is actually struggling with, using user conversations, data, and the product itself. Then being specific about which part of your solution addresses that problem and why you expect it to work, rather than presenting a design and reasoning backwards from it. Knowing what you're solving is the part that decides whether the rest of the work matters.
  3. Build working prototypes yourself.
    We prototype with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Replit or whatever you work fastest in. The aim is something users can actually use within days, without waiting for engineering capacity. This is a core part of the job rather than an occasional extra.
  4. Hypotheses and metrics, not only design.
    You'd own specific product branches together with the hypotheses behind them, and work with the PM as a peer rather than as a service function. In practice that means naming the metric you expect to move before you start, and being the person who knows afterwards whether it moved. Branch activation and branch cancel rate are what we're currently judged on.
  5. Neat and clean design solutions.
    We care about solutions that are simple and consistent: sensible structure, careful spacing and typography, states and edge cases handled, and nothing on the screen that doesn't need to be there. Speed of building doesn't excuse a sloppy interface.

What's in the role for you

  • A team to learn from. The product team is experienced and includes people who previously worked at Miro, Palta, Uber, and Bolt. Everyone here runs their own initiatives, so the people around you already work the way this role asks you to. At this size you'd be in the room when product decisions get made rather than hearing the outcome later, and you'd get direct feedback on your thinking from people who have done this at larger scale.
  • Shaping mobile learning in a product with more than a million users. SmartyMe is live and used daily, so the changes you make show up in the numbers within days rather than quarters. Very few designers get to work at that scale of feedback on something they own outright.
  • Freedom to test hypotheses. If you can prototype it, you can test it. You don't need to assemble consensus or wait for a planning cycle to try an idea, and production has clear risk guardrails rather than blanket approvals.
  • Broad scope for one seat. Design, product decisions, and building in a single role. It's a rare combination to practise in one place, and the three skills compound rather than compete.
  • A short path to decisions. You'd report directly to the VP of Product and partner with a strong product manager, with no layers between your work and the people who decide. AI tools are part of how we work rather than a side experiment.

Technical skills

3+ years of product design including mobile apps.

  • Product design experience: hands-on work on real products, ideally mobile-first consumer apps. EdTech, wellness, or habit-building products are a plus.
  • Prototyping with AI tools: you build working prototypes yourself in Claude Code, Codex, Replit, or similar. This is a requirement. Pushing small production changes is a plus, not an expectation.
  • Product and metrics literacy: you can express work as a hypothesis, covering what should change, roughly how much, and what would indicate you were wrong.
  • AI features: comfortable designing around AI-powered functionality and hypotheses that keep shifting.
  • Figma: components, auto layout, variants, prototyping, versioning.

Nice to have: activation and retention work, games or content-heavy products, design systems, something you've shipped independently.

How you work

These carry as much weight in our decision as the technical skills above.

  • Ownership (the primary requirement). You take a problem and stay accountable for the outcome, not for the hand-off. That means deciding without full information, unblocking yourself, chasing the people you need, and reporting where things stand before anyone asks. The team is compact and nobody will be managing you through the steps.
  • Proactivity. Identifying what needs doing and starting it, rather than waiting for the problem to be assigned and defined. A meaningful share of the work you do here will be work you proposed.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Problems arrive underdefined, and turning them into something workable is part of the job rather than a prerequisite for starting it.
  • Preference for shipping. Getting to a rough working version early rather than extending the planning stage.
  • Attention to craft. Spacing, clarity, copy, and the details in between.
  • Direct communication. Explaining design decisions openly in Slack, Figma, and live sessions, raising problems early, and disagreeing when you think a decision is wrong.
  • Learning speed. We weight rate of improvement more heavily than years of experience.

Hiring process

  1. Portfolio screening. We look at how you framed problems and what came out of them, including the parts that didn't go smoothly. Cases with the reasoning shown tell us more than a set of finished screens.
  2. Recruiter screening. Basics, level, motivation, and logistics.
  3. Job and partnership fit interview (45 min). With the SmartyMe product manager, the person you'd work with most closely. The actual work of the role and how the two of you would divide and share it.
  4. Team fit interview (45 to 60 min). With the VP of Product. Your background and product thinking, mostly through specific cases: something you initiated yourself, something you owned end to end, and something you decided without enough information.
  5. Live working session (60 to 90 min). The final and main stage. We bring a real SmartyMe problem with incomplete data and no spec. We narrow it together, form a hypothesis, and you build something during the session using your own tools. We're interested in the reasoning and in how quickly you get to something real, not in a finished answer.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Operations Coordinator to keep day-to-day business operations organized, visible, and moving efficiently across multiple departments.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows, tracking performance, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring teams follow through on operational priorities.

You’ll work across functions including:

  • Operations
  • Finance
  • HR
  • Customer Service
  • Logistics
  • IT
  • Vendor Management

You’ll serve as a key coordination point between teams while giving leadership clear visibility into KPIs, deadlines, risks, and operational performance.

Process & Workflow Coordination

  • Track operational workflows across multiple departments.
  • Monitor tasks, deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Ensure recurring processes are completed according to established SOPs.
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding action items.

KPI Tracking & Operational Reporting

    • Weekly operational reports
    • Monthly KPI summaries
    • Leadership updates
    • Performance insights
  • Track metrics including:
    • Productivity
    • Utilization
    • Workflow completion
    • Operational efficiency
  • Ensure data is accurate, current, and actionable.
  • Help leadership understand operational performance and areas requiring attention.

Documentation & SOP Management

  • Create, maintain, and update:
    • SOPs
    • Process maps
    • Operational checklists
    • Compliance documentation
  • Maintain organized records within systems such as:
    • Google Drive
    • SharePoint
    • Notion
  • Ensure documentation is easy to find, current, and audit-ready.
  • Help standardize recurring operational processes.

Vendor & Partner Coordination

    • Deliverables
    • Timelines
    • Invoices
    • Service updates
  • Monitor vendor commitments and SLAs.
  • Follow up on outstanding requirements.
  • Escalate delays or performance issues proactively.
  • Maintain organized vendor documentation and approvals.

Cross-Functional Operations Support

  • Coordinate recurring workflows between departments.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on deadlines and responsibilities.
  • Support leadership with:
    • Operational research
    • Reporting
    • Analysis
    • Ad hoc initiatives
  • Help maintain clear communication and accountability across teams.

Compliance & Operational Controls

  • Ensure operational activities align with established company processes and requirements.
  • Maintain accurate logs, records, and tracking systems.
  • Support audit readiness through organized documentation.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

raw.description:
Join Us in Bringing Hope to Life

Our purpose is to bring hope to life by enabling life‑changing therapies for patients around the globe, creating a healthier and happier tomorrow. To advance this purpose, we rely on team members who value excellence, collaboration, and meaningful work. If this resonates with you, we invite you to explore the role further and apply.

Job Summary

We are seeking a (Senior) Director of Business Development to join our Global Business Development organization and drive strategic growth within our Microbial and Mammalian business segment. Reporting to the Global Head of Business Development, this role plays a critical part in expanding AGC Biologics’ footprint by identifying, evaluating, and closing new development and manufacturing partnerships across the United States.

The Senior Director builds strong, consultative relationships with prospective clients, shaping high‑value opportunities and contributing to the advancement of next‑generation therapies. This position offers the opportunity to influence commercial strategy, collaborate with global cross-functional partners, and create meaningful impact in a fast‑moving, complex CDMO environment.

About Our Business Development Team

You’ll join a highly collaborative global team that partners closely across technical, legal, marketing, and operational functions to support customers throughout the full development and manufacturing lifecycle. Our team operates in a dynamic, growth‑oriented environment where strategic thinking, relationship building, and commercial excellence drive success. We focus on delivering high‑quality opportunities aligned with our mission to bring hope to life through biopharmaceutical innovation.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, engage, and close new microbial development and manufacturing partnerships across the U.S.

  • Build and maintain strategic client relationships that expand market presence and drive revenue growth.

  • Develop and execute a targeted sales territory plan aligned with annual commercial goals.

  • Effectively communicate AGC Biologics’ technical and operational capabilities to key decision‑makers within prospective organizations.

  • Lead and coordinate client site visits, including agenda planning, cross-functional engagement, and structured follow‑up.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to shape strategies and materials supporting U.S. commercial initiatives.

  • Manage pipeline activity within CRM systems to ensure accuracy, visibility, and timely follow‑up.

  • Partner with global cross‑functional teams—including Technical Operations, Legal, Finance, and Program Management—to advance opportunities through due diligence and contract execution.

  • Provide meaningful market insights based on customer interactions, competitive dynamics, and industry trends.

  • Represent AGC Biologics at conferences, trade shows, and relevant industry events.

  • Consistently deliver high‑quality opportunities aligned with company growth strategies and leadership expectations.

Your Leadership & Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical, strategic, and communication skills with the ability to distill complex information into clear messaging.

  • Focused on value creation, with the ability to prioritize and execute on the highest‑impact opportunities.

  • Highly organized and resourceful, capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

  • Skilled at tailoring communication styles to diverse stakeholders and delivering compelling presentations.

  • Customer‑focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and high-quality engagements.

  • Collaborative and team‑oriented, operating in alignment with AGC Biologics’ Core Values: Knowledge, Trust, Quality, Ingenuity, Accountability, and Teamwork.

  • Committed to continuous improvement and commercial excellence.

Your Experience & Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of successful business development or sales experience, preferably within the CDMO or broader life sciences/biopharmaceutical sector.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated success in developing relationships, presenting to senior leadership, and closing complex technical solutions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to various audiences.

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% for client meetings, industry events, and internal engagements.

Formalities

Location: Remote in the San Francisco Bay Area
Schedule: Full-time
Travel: ~50% domestic, with occasional international travel
Compensation Range: $164,400 - $266,750

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in the United States. From our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market. 

We are a collaborative, inclusive, and equal‑opportunity organization where team members are valued for their expertise, teamwork, and ingenuity.

About Us
At Tradeify.co, we are not just another proprietary trading firm; we are a dynamic and innovative force, specializing in multi-asset trading through sophisticated, data-driven strategies and cutting-edge technology. We partner with industry leaders like NinjaTrader and Tradovate to provide our traders with a best-in-class experience. Our core mission is to empower exceptional traders by providing significant capital, state-of-the-art technology, and unwavering support, enabling them to thrive in the complexities of global financial markets.
We are deeply rooted in a culture of quantitative analysis, rigorous risk management, and perpetual learning.
As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory, we are seeking talented Trader Support Specialists to work with our prop traders during the LATAM (Latin America) time zones.

The Opportunity

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Tradeify.co traders and customers, owning interactions from start to resolution through all support channels, including live chat, email, and Discord.
  • Accurately identify, assess, and efficiently resolve a wide range of inquiries, spanning from general account questions to more complex technical and operational issues related to trading platforms, data feeds, and execution.
  • Use technical ability to master trading platforms, internal tools, and proprietary systems, maintaining in-depth product knowledge through ongoing education.
  • Skillfully troubleshoot incoming inquiries, determining severity, and escalating to appropriate internal teams such as Compliance, Operations, and Technology when necessary, ensuring prompt resolution and diligent follow-up.
  • Make every trader interaction complete, using empathy as well as knowledge to provide white-glove care.
  • Actively participate in improving Tradeify.co’s trader-focused Learning Center and our internal knowledge bases to promote self-service capabilities for traders.
  • Contribute to team goals by focusing on customer satisfaction (CSAT), Quality Assurance, and overall response times.
  • Educate both existing and potential traders in their understanding of how Tradeify.co works.
  • Participate in beta testing new features and contribute to the overall growth and innovation of the company through idea generation and active participation in collaborative team projects.
  • Monitor trading systems for common issues and proactively identify potential problems that could impact the trader experience or operational flow.
  • Adhere strictly to all internal guidelines, compliance procedures, and industry best practices to ensure a secure, transparent, and trustworthy trading environment.
  • Potentially assist with data accuracy and reconciliation tasks as needed to support robust trading operations.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service, technical support, or operations role, preferably within a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to explain complex technical or financial information clearly, concisely, and empathetically.
  • Ability to type a minimum of 30 WPM.
  • Outstanding interaction with traders and customers is your top priority, demonstrating a reasonable understanding of white-glove care.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask effectively, prioritize competing demands, and manage time efficiently in a dynamic and high-pressure setting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving issues independently.
  • Proficiency in utilizing CRM software (e.g., Intercom, HubSpot) and other customer support tools to manage interactions and data.
  • Desire for proactive communication with colleagues and strong organizational skills.
  • Both goal- and results-oriented, with the ability to handle ambiguity with confidence and ease.
  • Willingness to notice and suggest improvements when necessary, and actively seeks feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Willingness and flexibility to work hours aligned with the US trading session, which may include early mornings or late evenings to ensure comprehensive coverage.
  • Must be fluent in English

Nice to Haves

  • Strong familiarity with or demonstrated genuine interest in prop trading, FX or Futures trading, cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and global financial markets.
  • Basic understanding of trading concepts, various financial products (e.g., futures, FX), or the operational intricacies of proprietary trading firms.
  • Prior experience with specific trading platforms such as NinjaTrader or Tradovate, TradingView etc.
  • Experience with community engagement platforms commonly used in the trading space, such as Telegram or Discord.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Interview: If we like your initial application, expect to schedule an interview with a member of our recruitment team. This interview will focus on getting to know you a bit more and will explain the culture of the company. We want to know more about why you want to join our team, how you feel about our company, and how it fits into your overall career plan to make sure this is the right place for you.
Interview(s) with your future manager: This is to make sure that you are a fit for the role you are applying to and to explore your career history. In this interview, we’ll learn more about the hard and soft skills you possess to help determine if you’d be a good fit for us.
Final Interview(s) with Leadership: Depending on the role, you may be interviewed by our senior leaders to assess your strategic thinking and fit within the broader team.

raw.description:
About the Role

In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis.

Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data.

Job Type: Freelance
Location: Bangladesh (work from home)
Work Schedule: Part-time - 10+ hours per week. Flexible - work whenever you want.
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: TBC
Rate: 6 USD per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present.

  • Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., an annotator based in Germany validating that the media is authentic to the Bengali [Bangladesh] linguistic and cultural context).

  • Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines.

  • Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models.

What we’re looking for:

  • Must be currently living in Bangladesh.

  • Native-level written and spoken fluency in Bengali.

  • Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop.

  • Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.

  • (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

About Us
At Tradeify.co, we are not just another proprietary trading firm; we are a dynamic and innovative force, specializing in multi-asset trading through sophisticated, data-driven strategies and cutting-edge technology. We partner with industry leaders like NinjaTrader and Tradovate to provide our traders with a best-in-class experience. Our core mission is to empower exceptional traders by providing significant capital, state-of-the-art technology, and unwavering support, enabling them to thrive in the complexities of global financial markets.
We are deeply rooted in a culture of quantitative analysis, rigorous risk management, and perpetual learning.
As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory, we are seeking talented Trader Support Specialists to work with our prop traders during the LATAM (Latin America) time zones.

The Opportunity

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Tradeify.co traders and customers, owning interactions from start to resolution through all support channels, including live chat, email, and Discord.
  • Accurately identify, assess, and efficiently resolve a wide range of inquiries, spanning from general account questions to more complex technical and operational issues related to trading platforms, data feeds, and execution.
  • Use technical ability to master trading platforms, internal tools, and proprietary systems, maintaining in-depth product knowledge through ongoing education.
  • Skillfully troubleshoot incoming inquiries, determining severity, and escalating to appropriate internal teams such as Compliance, Operations, and Technology when necessary, ensuring prompt resolution and diligent follow-up.
  • Make every trader interaction complete, using empathy as well as knowledge to provide white-glove care.
  • Actively participate in improving Tradeify.co’s trader-focused Learning Center and our internal knowledge bases to promote self-service capabilities for traders.
  • Contribute to team goals by focusing on customer satisfaction (CSAT), Quality Assurance, and overall response times.
  • Educate both existing and potential traders in their understanding of how Tradeify.co works.
  • Participate in beta testing new features and contribute to the overall growth and innovation of the company through idea generation and active participation in collaborative team projects.
  • Monitor trading systems for common issues and proactively identify potential problems that could impact the trader experience or operational flow.
  • Adhere strictly to all internal guidelines, compliance procedures, and industry best practices to ensure a secure, transparent, and trustworthy trading environment.
  • Potentially assist with data accuracy and reconciliation tasks as needed to support robust trading operations.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service, technical support, or operations role, preferably within a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to explain complex technical or financial information clearly, concisely, and empathetically.
  • Ability to type a minimum of 30 WPM.
  • Outstanding interaction with traders and customers is your top priority, demonstrating a reasonable understanding of white-glove care.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask effectively, prioritize competing demands, and manage time efficiently in a dynamic and high-pressure setting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving issues independently.
  • Proficiency in utilizing CRM software (e.g., Intercom, HubSpot) and other customer support tools to manage interactions and data.
  • Desire for proactive communication with colleagues and strong organizational skills.
  • Both goal- and results-oriented, with the ability to handle ambiguity with confidence and ease.
  • Willingness to notice and suggest improvements when necessary, and actively seeks feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Willingness and flexibility to work hours aligned with the US trading session, which may include early mornings or late evenings to ensure comprehensive coverage.
  • Must be fluent in English

Nice to Haves

  • Strong familiarity with or demonstrated genuine interest in prop trading, FX or Futures trading, cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and global financial markets.
  • Basic understanding of trading concepts, various financial products (e.g., futures, FX), or the operational intricacies of proprietary trading firms.
  • Prior experience with specific trading platforms such as NinjaTrader or Tradovate, TradingView etc.
  • Experience with community engagement platforms commonly used in the trading space, such as Telegram or Discord.
Our Hiring Process
Recruiter Interview: If we like your initial application, expect to schedule an interview with a member of our recruitment team. This interview will focus on getting to know you a bit more and will explain the culture of the company. We want to know more about why you want to join our team, how you feel about our company, and how it fits into your overall career plan to make sure this is the right place for you.
Interview(s) with your future manager: This is to make sure that you are a fit for the role you are applying to and to explore your career history. In this interview, we’ll learn more about the hard and soft skills you possess to help determine if you’d be a good fit for us.
Final Interview(s) with Leadership: Depending on the role, you may be interviewed by our senior leaders to assess your strategic thinking and fit within the broader team.

raw.description:
About the Role

In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis.

Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data.

Job Type: Freelance
Location: Bangladesh (work from home)
Work Schedule: Part-time - 10+ hours per week. Flexible - work whenever you want.
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: TBC
Rate: 6 USD per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present.

  • Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., an annotator based in Germany validating that the media is authentic to the Bengali [Bangladesh] linguistic and cultural context).

  • Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines.

  • Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models.

What we’re looking for:

  • Must be currently living in Bangladesh.

  • Native-level written and spoken fluency in Bengali.

  • Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop.

  • Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.

  • (Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

As Head of Growth, you will own the full commercial motion for OEM accounts — from defining the ideal customer profile to closing the first enterprise contracts. You'll work directly with the founding team and have meaningful influence over product direction, partnerships, and revenue strategy.

What You'll Do

  • Source OEM leads and open relationships across market access and reimbursement teams at medical device companies.

  • Run discovery sessions to map OEM workflows and identify where the platform creates the most value.

  • Define and refine the ideal customer profile (ICP) and build a repeatable sales playbook for OEM partnerships.

  • Own OEM accounts end-to-end — from first call through signed contract and ongoing relationship management.

  • Attend key industry conferences and build community partnerships to extend reach within target specialties.

  • Research and identify growth opportunities across procurement, market access intelligence, and reimbursement infrastructure.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, clinical, and commercialization teams to translate OEM needs into roadmap priorities.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 4–7 years of experience working in medical device companies, with direct exposure to go-to-market and reimbursement-related initiatives.

  • Direct experience in reimbursement or market access within the medical device industry — this is a dealbreaker requirement.

  • Deep understanding of the OEM ecosystem: how decisions are made, who controls budget, and how reimbursement risk translates to commercial outcomes.

  • Proven ability to source OEM leads and manage accounts from first conversation to signed contract.

  • Comfortable operating in a zero-to-one environment with limited infrastructure — you build the playbook, not follow one.

  • Based in New York City and able to work hybrid (in-person as needed) with willingness to travel for conferences.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience in endovascular, cardiovascular, or interventional radiology specialties.

  • Cross-functional exposure spanning market access, reimbursement, supply chain, and R&D.

  • Actively uses AI tools in day-to-day workflow — a strong positive signal for this role.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $130,000 – $200,000 annually

  • Equity: Meaningful equity stake commensurate with the seniority and impact of the role

  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Location

This role is based in New York City, NY and operates on a hybrid schedule. Some in-person collaboration is expected, along with periodic travel to industry conferences.

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home and vacation rental portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. The Opportunity:

As a QA Analyst/Tester at Visio Lending, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software solutions. You'll design, build, and maintain automated test suites, execute comprehensive quality assurance testing, and leverage emerging AI-powered testing tools to improve test coverage and efficiency. Working closely with Engineering team, you'll identify and resolve issues early in the development lifecycle, helping deliver high-quality software and an exceptional user experience.

If you are a detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys finding issues before customers do, has a passion for improving software quality through both manual and automated testing, and is excited to embrace AI-driven testing tools and continuous learning, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for web applications using tools such as Playwright
  • Build and run automated smoke, regression, and end-to-end tests to validate new features and releases
  • Evaluate and apply emerging AI-powered testing tools to automate and accelerate QA operations

  • Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, and verify fixes
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and monitor results
  • Collaborate with engineers and product teams to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria
  • Participate in code and test reviews to uphold quality standards
  • Maintain clear documentation for test coverage, processes, and results
  • Contribute to agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives

  • 2-5 years of professional experience in software quality assurance or test automation
  • Hands-on experience building automated tests with modern frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, Cypress)
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language used for test automation (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python)
  • Comfort adopting emerging AI-based testing tools to automate and improve testing operations
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and defect tracking
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Ability to write and run SQL queries to validate data
  • Strong attention to detail and quality-first mindest
  • Curiosity and eagerness to adopt new tools, including emerging AI testing technologies
  • Analytical, methodical approach to isolating and reproducing defects
  • Effective communication and collaboration within a cross-functional team
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, printer, scanner, copier, fax, telephone, personal computer, and other peripheral devices

What We Prefer to Find:

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and integrating automated tests into build pipelines
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure

  • ISTQB or similar QA certification

Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive QA Automation Engineer to join our team. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our applications through a combination of manual and automated testing across front-end and back-end systems.
The ideal candidate is passionate about software quality, enjoys working in a collaborative environment, and is motivated to improve testing processes, tools, and automation coverage.

About Nucleus Security

Nucleus Security is transforming how security and development teams manage vulnerabilities at a scale. Our platform unifies vulnerability data across scanners and environments, enabling organizations to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities efficiently. Through our integrations, we empower customers to ingest data from their existing tools with minimal setup and maximum reliability.

Core Responsibilities

What You Will Do

  1. Ensure the quality and reliability of assigned products across the full stack — UI, APIs, and data — defining test approach and risk coverage with the QA Manager, and leveraging AI tools to improve coverage and efficiency
  2. Build, extend, and improve scalable automation frameworks in Selenium and Playwright that the team relies on, reducing manual testing effort and increasing confidence in every release
  3. Act as a quality advocate within the team — reviewing test code, sharing testing practices with peers, and raising design concerns early enough to prevent defects rather than catch them

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Plan and execute test coverage for complex, cross-system features, including functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Design and execute manual and automated test cases covering functionality, performance, and reliability, including positive, negative, and edge cases
  • Assess risk and prioritize testing effort, making clear recommendations on depth of coverage versus delivery timelines
  • Map test cases to business requirements and functional designs, ensuring traceability and identifying gaps before development begins
  • Investigate complex or intermittent failures to root cause, distinguishing product defects from test instability and environment issues
  • Document and report defects, verify fixes, and ensure timely resolution in collaboration with development teams

Database & Data Validation

  • Write and execute complex SQL queries to validate data integrity, transformations, and business logic across the application stack
  • Verify data accuracy through ingestion, normalization, and processing workflows — record counts, deduplication, field-level mapping, and malformed or partial data
  • Validate database interactions triggered by UI and API operations, and test data migrations, schema changes, and backfills for correctness and backward compatibility
  • Build and maintain reusable test data sets and database setup and teardown routines for reliable, repeatable automated runs

Automation & Frameworks

  • Implement and review automated test scripts using Java with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright, following best practices such as the Page Object Model
  • Contribute to the architecture and long-term health of automation frameworks — structure, reusable components, reporting, and test data management
  • Incorporate database validation into automated suites through query-based assertions and programmatic test data setup
  • Improve automation reliability by reducing flakiness, execution time, and maintenance cost as suites grow
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support optimization within DevOps workflows, including parallel execution
  • Support performance and scale testing, and recommend tools and processes that measurably improve QA effectiveness

AI-Assisted Testing

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools for test case generation, test data creation, and defect analysis
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling, such as Playwright MCP, for AI-driven browser interaction, exploratory testing, and test script generation
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools for building and maintaining automation scripts, with sound judgment about where AI output needs human validation
  • Ability to apply AI thoughtfully within QA workflows and share what works with the rest of the team

Collaboration & QA Practices

  • Partner with the QA Manager, developers, and product managers to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria
  • Support and mentor less experienced QA engineers through technical guidance, code review feedback, and knowledge sharing
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, surfacing testability and reliability concerns early
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and standards across the team

What we’re looking for:

Required

  • 8+ years in software quality assurance, with at least 5 years in test automation
  • Strong programming skills in Java, with demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, reviewable test code
  • Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright, and with design patterns such as the Page Object Model
  • Experience contributing to the design or significant refactoring of an automation framework, not just writing tests within one
  • Solid API testing experience and strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience validating application behavior directly against relational databases
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD tooling and version control, with experience running automation reliably within pipelines
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills, with a track record of driving complex issues to root cause

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience working in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or security-focused products and environments
  • Familiarity with security concepts such as vulnerabilities, risk scoring, APIs, and data protection practices
  • Experience with MCP servers or agent-based testing workflows beyond basic tool usage
  • Experience testing ETL or data pipelines, or working with large-scale or NoSQL data stores
  • Experience with performance or load testing, cloud environments, or containerized test infrastructure

Common Skills & Traits

  • Self-starter with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to wear multiple hats in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, with the maturity to disagree constructively
  • Ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and frameworks — and to teach them to others
  • Willingness to fail fast, iterate, and improve

Why Nucleus?
  • Nucleus is a truly unique solution that’s defining a market AND making an actual impact.  
  • We’re biased, but you will get to work with one of the best teams in security. We have a lot to get done and we work extremely hard, but we have fun in the process.  
  • Work with a high-performing team that values creativity, autonomy, and innovation.
  • Collaborate on meaningful products that improve the security posture of major organizations.
  • Enjoy flexible remote work arrangements and a strong emphasis on work-life balance.

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will build the infrastructure and systems that power A1's AI capabilities.

You will design and operate the systems behind the AI stack, from model training and evaluation to deployment, inference, observability, and continuous improvement.

You will work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product engineers to turn models into reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production systems. You will build the platforms, tooling, and infrastructure that enable the team to experiment quickly and bring AI capabilities to production with confidence.

Focus

  • Build and operate the ML infrastructure and platforms powering A1’s AI products

  • Design systems for model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, and experimentation

  • Build and optimise model serving and inference infrastructure for high-throughput and low-latency workloads

  • Improve reliability, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency of AI systems

  • Develop reliable pipelines for data preparation, training, evaluation, model release, and continuous improvement

  • Build platforms and tooling that enable AI engineers and researchers to experiment, evaluate, and ship models faster

  • Develop evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure to measure model quality, performance, and regressions

  • Build production observability, monitoring, tracing, and alerting for AI/ML workloads

  • Improve AI systems across reliability, scalability, latency, throughput, and cost

  • Identify bottlenecks across the ML stack and continuously improve system performance

  • Work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product teams to turn evolving model requirements into production-ready infrastructure

Tech Stack

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • LLM and ML serving infrastructure such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Cloud infrastructure

  • Distributed systems

  • ML/data pipelines and workflow orchestration

  • GPU infrastructure and performance tooling

  • Vector databases and retrieval infrastructure

Ideal Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems

  • Experience building ML infrastructure, platforms, or production machine learning systems

  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to come and join our global business.
Reporting directly to the General Manager of Europe, and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and potential partners, you will be 100% focused on bringing in new business development.
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge and wants to make an impact.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively

Added bonus

    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.

Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem.

As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.

About The Role:

We are seeking a relationship-first professional to serve as our Regulatory Partnership Director. You will build trust with state healthcare regulatory boards and agencies to support the growth and expansion of Propelus This role is grounded in credibility; taking the time to understand stakeholder priorities and operational challenges, and integrating that insight into the CE Broker solution, and ultimately delivering measurable value.

This is a consultative partnership role, not a traditional high-volume sales position. Your work will focus on earning trust within government environments, navigate multi-year decision cycles with patience, and maintaining the discipline needed to move opportunities forward.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned state partners, guiding them on how to improve operational efficiency and strengthen compliance.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute Relationship Cadence: Maintain a consistent and proactive communication schedule with assigned state regulatory boards and agencies. Invest time to understand local missions and constraints.

    • You will drive active, values-focused conversations about creating operational efficiency, new ways to modernize government, and support the regulatory boards in their core mission and supporting healthcare pros in their daily needs.

  • Tactical Solution Mapping: Translate the capabilities of our product, CE Broker, into specific outcomes tied to agency efficiency and public protection. Deliver business cases and proposals that address the immediate needs of board staff and leadership.

  • Manage Opportunities Through the Lifecycle: Advance opportunities using a consultative approach. Create momentum by aligning our implementation timelines with agency deadlines and strategic plans.

    • You will operate with a thoughtful urgency, knowing when and how to navigate strategic opportunities to close deals in complex environments.

  • Regulatory Knowledge Application: Maintain an up-to-date understanding of state licensing frameworks and Continuing Education (CE) compliance for your assigned territories and professions.

  • Pipeline Coordination: Maintain a healthy and accurate pipeline by proactively surfacing new opportunities within existing or prospective accounts. Leverage industry trends and new regulation requirements to identify where Propelus can solve emerging compliance gaps.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless transition from contract signature to "go-live."

  • Operational Discipline: Maintain accurate visibility into opportunities via CRM (Salesforce). Bring a structure to forecasting and follow-through to ensure no stakeholder request is left unanswered.

We Would Like You To Have:

  • 3–5+ years of experience at the State level working directly with regulatory boards, healthcare regulatory environment, or a related field.

  • Proven track record of building and maintaining relationships within state agencies and/or licensing boards, with an ability to build rapport at both the operational and leadership levels.
