raw.description:
The Marketing Manager builds and runs the target account program for software vendors. The role decides which vendors Software Finder pursues, develops enough understanding of each vendor business to build a credible commercial case, and designs personalized campaigns that convert priority accounts into qualified meetings and activated programs.

This is a hands-on role positioned between marketing and business development. Research matters only when it leads to a clear commercial action, and performance is judged on meetings, opportunities and revenue rather than campaign volume.

Key responsibilities

Target account strategy and selection

  • Own the account-based marketing strategy for vendors most likely to invest in our offerings.

  • Prioritize accounts on revenue potential, category fit, demand generation maturity and likelihood of conversion.

  • Maintain an account scoring model covering category fit, commercial potential, vendor maturity, competitive activity, relationship strength, product fit and timing signals such as new funding, product launches, hiring or category expansion.

  • Classify accounts into strategic, growth and programmatic tiers, and set the level of personalization and investment each tier receives. Depth of personalization must reflect account value rather than being applied evenly.

  • Review the account list on an ongoing basis, removing or downgrading accounts that show weak fit or limited commercial potential.

Account research and intelligence

  • Research each priority vendor: products, software categories, target market, competitors, paid search presence, marketplace visibility, current campaigns and likely demand generation priorities.

  • Map buying committees across demand generation, performance marketing, account-based marketing, product marketing, growth, partnerships and senior marketing leadership.

  • Develop a clear commercial hypothesis for every strategic account: why the vendor should work with Software Finder, which product is the right entry point and what evidence will be required to win.

  • Maintain a standard account research and account brief format so research stays consistent and reusable.

Positioning and campaign design

  • Ensure that the messaging used for each vendor category, market position aligns with current acquisition strategy and likely business challenges/outcomes.

  • Design one to one, one to few and one to many campaigns for priority vendors and categories.

  • Group similar vendors into repeatable category plays across verticals such as HR and payroll, medical, ERP, construction, CMMS and legal technology.

  • Build a competitive entry strategy for vendors already investing in similar products.

Campaign execution

  • Coordinate personalized email, LinkedIn, content, paid advertising, webinars, direct outreach, executive engagement and event-based campaigns.

  • Create or commission account specific content including account briefs, landing pages, presentations, category opportunity reports, benchmarking, ROI scenarios and outreach messages.

  • Identify accounts where CEO, founder or senior leadership involvement improves access or credibility, and prepare those executives with the right context and message.

  • Run opportunity acceleration campaigns for priority accounts already in the pipeline, addressing objections, engaging additional stakeholders or restarting stalled conversations.

Business development enablement

  • Provide business development with an actionable account brief covering stakeholder maps, engagement history, recommended product, talking points, likely objections, suggested responses, next best action and estimated commercial potential.

  • Orchestrate marketing and business development touches so target accounts receive one coherent message rather than disconnected communications.

  • Run a regular target account review with business development and maintain clear agreement on account ownership, outreach coordination and follow up.

Event based account marketing

  • Own the target account motion around each selected event. Product Marketing retains ownership of overall event selection and planning.

  • Identify priority accounts and decision makers expected to attend, research speakers, sponsors and exhibitors, and rank accounts by meeting priority.

  • Run personalized pre-event outreach, coordinate business development and leadership involvement, and secure meetings before travel rather than relying on unplanned networking.

  • Prepare briefs for attendees, track onsite engagement and next steps, and coordinate account specific post event campaigns.

Measurement, market feedback and budget

  • Track visits, content interaction, email engagement, event activity, meetings and other buying signals at the account level.

  • Work with Marketing Operations to maintain reporting on target account coverage, account engagement, meeting and pipeline performance, account progression through to realized revenue, and play performance by category, product, message, channel and event.

  • Capture and circulate account level market feedback: objections, competitive intelligence, product requests and the reasons accounts engage or decline.

  • Determine which account segments, messages, products, channels and personalization levels produce the best commercial results.

  • Recommend and manage account-based marketing spend against engagement, qualified meetings, opportunities, activations and realized revenue.

Experience and skills required

  • 5 to 7 years in B2B marketing, including at least two years in account-based marketing, demand generation or field marketing.

  • A track record of target account programs that produced qualified meetings and pipeline, not only engagement metrics.

  • Strong research ability. Able to read a company website, ad presence and market position and form a commercial view quickly.

  • Commercial judgment about where to concentrate effort, including which accounts justify deep personalization and which do not.

  • Confident writing personalized outreach, account briefs and commercial narratives in clear English.

  • Comfortable working closely with sales and being measured on pipeline.

  • Hands on experience with CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot, plus LinkedIn campaign tools.

  • Bachelor degree in marketing, business or a related field.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing to software or SaaS vendors.

  • Familiarity with software marketplaces and review platforms.

  • Experience running event-led account campaigns.

  • Exposure to intent data and account engagement scoring.

About the company

iSpeedToLead runs a real estate lead marketplace focused on motivated home-seller leads for investors, wholesalers, and operators. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: they see key details before they buy, with transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. The JV program places unsold motivated seller leads with real estate operators who have the teams, follow-up systems, and closing ability to convert them into revenue.

Role overview

The JV Partnership Manager owns who gets into the JV program, how they perform, and whether they stay. You will recruit and close new JV partners, onboard them properly, coach them to perform, hold them accountable, retain the ones worth keeping, and grow their value over time. You are not here to collect signups - you are here to build a partner base that produces revenue consistently and grows month over month.

Responsibilities

  • Recruit, qualify, and close high-quality JV partners who have real acquisition teams and real closing ability

  • Onboard new partners properly: set expectations early, drive activation fast, and prevent stalling

  • Coach partners directly on follow-up, lead handling, prioritization, and pipeline execution

  • Organize monthly partner meetings, performance reviews, and accountability check-ins

  • Retain strong partners through results, not just relationship maintenance

  • Identify upsell opportunities inside the existing partner base and act on them

  • Catch disengagement and performance drops early, not after a partner has already mentally quit

  • Analyze why top partners outperform and push lower performers to close the gap

  • Protect the quality of the partner base by filtering out weak operators before they waste lead flow

  • Build repeatable systems for recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and growing JV partners

  • Work cross-functionally to make sure partners are supported, integrated, and operationally set up


Requirements

  • 2+ years in partner recruitment, affiliate management, business development, or any role where you recruited, closed, and managed external revenue-generating relationships

  • Proven ability to sell a partnership, set expectations, and hold partners to them

  • Experience coaching or managing external partners on execution and performance, not just maintaining relationships

  • Strong enough commercially to spot the difference between a serious operator and someone who interviews well but will not perform

  • Comfortable managing 30+ active partner relationships without losing control of any of them

  • Organized, responsive, and high-accountability - you follow up before anyone asks you to

  • Clear written and verbal English

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where outcomes matter more than activity


Nice to have

  • Experience in real estate investing, wholesaling, or lead generation

  • Background in JV structuring, affiliate programs, or revenue-share partnerships

  • Experience building a partner channel from early stage or scaling an existing one

  • Familiarity with CRM tools, lead management platforms, and performance tracking systems


What we offer

  • A role with real ownership over a revenue channel that directly impacts company growth

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based compensation - your results are visible and rewarded

  • A lean, fast-moving team where operators thrive and bureaucracy does not exist

  • Remote flexibility

  • A company that treats JV partnerships as a core growth engine, not a side project

raw.title: Investment Lead
raw.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

This role is on the Intercept team, which is part of Stripe's broader collection of public goods initiatives, including Frontier.

Respiratory viruses kill 1 million people a year, cost us $600B annually, disrupt everyday life, and periodically threaten civilization. Recent breakthroughs may make it possible to develop and deploy broad-spectrum preventatives and air cleaning technologies that defend against common respiratory infections. Intercept is a $500M philanthropic initiative that aims to radically reduce the burden of respiratory infections, and eventually eliminate them altogether. Learn more about Intercept via our launch post and our website

What you’ll do

Intercept is looking for an experienced biotech/biohealth investor to join our team.

We’re working to make sure the portfolio of technologies needed to radically reduce the burden of respiratory viruses exists. We have two main focus areas: air-cleaning technologies (ACT’s) and broad-spectrum preventatives (BSPs). For BSPs, our goal is to advance 2+ products that meet our target product profile through Phase 2. We make both grants and investments, using the most capital-efficient tool to advance our target product profile.

Initially, this role will be focused on building internal investment processes, investment thesis, and supporting Intercept in establishing the investment function. Ultimately this role will focus on sourcing, diligencing, and executing on pipeline opportunities to make equity and/or grant investments in companies that have the most promising BSPs against our target product profile (TPP). In addition, the role will be responsible for portfolio management to make sure portfolio projects successfully advance their products by helping to remove bottlenecks and accelerate timelines. To effectively accomplish this work, the Investment Lead will develop views on the most promising approaches, identify new cutting edge areas of science, understand key product development inflection points, including mapping key technical and clinical/regulatory bottlenecks and developing plans to de-risk / mitigate them.

We need someone who can go deep on scientific and development diligence while also zooming out to synthesize how findings impact our capital deployment plan and long-term goals. A successful candidate will be action-oriented and comfortable working independently (vs. waiting to be told what to do) and a great communicator who can translate complex science for diverse audiences.

Intercept is a small team; you'll work with the entire team, many partners, and wear many hats. You'll own specific outcomes end-to-end and have a chance to contribute to BSP strategy over time.

Responsibilities

  • Expand the pipeline of candidates. Proactively engage networks (researchers, investors, founders, funders, etc.) to source new ideas and technologies. Manage referral channels (open RFP, referrals, etc.) and screen investment and grant opportunities.
  • Own projects through diligence and transaction execution. Advance companies through early and deep / technical diligence: evaluating science quality, development plans, team, and fit against our TPP. Drive the investment or grantmaking process, coordinating with internal and external legal and diligence consultants. Bring projects through internal approval processes and act as the internal owner/champion.
  • Develop points of view on technologies. Contribute to publishing a POV for the 5-10 most promising approaches (i.e., siRNA, T-cell vaccine, innate immune stimulators) and identify the key 'gating datapoints' that would make us kill or double down on that approach and when we'll get that datapoint (or if there is a gap).
  • Build and maintain the CRM. Help ensure our CRM captures ~all known projects, and we have a process to systematically learn about/capture the best new projects early.
  • Portfolio management. Supporting portfolio projects and leading on efforts to accelerate and support projects post investmentDetermine what would let the top projects in the field move 2x faster beyond funding and make sure those things happen.
  • Map demand-side bottlenecks. Help map key stakeholders and address key evidence needs and bottlenecks across regulatory, clinical, recommendations, reimbursement and adoption/uptake.

Future opportunities for growth

  • Lead investments independently. Grow into a more senior team lead, owning deals from start to finish, managing investment teams, and generating / pursuing new investment theses.
  • Shape capital deployment. Contribute to our capital deployment plan informed by a clear POV of the most promising approaches.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • MD/PhD in immunology or infectious disease with 2+ years of investing, BD/partnering, or grantmaking experience or minimum 5 years of biotech investor experience in immunology or infectious disease at VC fund
  • Experience with portfolio management, including portfolio construction and post-award management
  • Ability to translate scientific diligence into strategic investment recommendations and a coherent capital deployment view
  • Product development experience (and/or broad exposure via investing in or supporting companies)
  • Experience with project management from launch to completion / project quarterback with a high openness to getting hands dirty
  • Extremely self-directed, diligent, very fast learner, excellent communicator, very action oriented (vs talking about things)
  • Compelled by our mission to greatly reduce the burden of and risks from respiratory viruses

Preferred qualifications

  • Public health / global health / biosecurity experience
  • MBA or MPH degrees
  • Experience with issuing non-dilutive funding / grant programs

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: IST (GMT +5:30)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Operations Manager to bring structure, clarity, and execution discipline across multiple client environments.

This is a high-ownership, systems-driven role — not an administrative or coordination-only position. You’ll manage operations across multiple businesses simultaneously, identify operational gaps, build scalable processes, improve team accountability, and ensure priorities move from planning to execution.

The role sits at the intersection of Operations, Project Management, and HR, making it ideal for someone who understands both how businesses operate and how teams need to be structured to perform effectively.

What You’ll Own

Multi-Client Operations Management

  • Manage operations across multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • Quickly understand each client’s business model, priorities, workflows, and operational challenges.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous or fast-changing environments.
  • Establish clear priorities and maintain visibility across active workstreams.
  • Adapt operational frameworks to different businesses without creating unnecessary complexity.

Delivery & Execution Management

  • Maintain structured trackers for projects, deliverables, owners, and deadlines.
  • Ensure commitments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Identify bottlenecks before they affect delivery.
  • Proactively resolve execution gaps and escalate critical risks when necessary.
  • Prioritize high-impact initiatives while pushing back on low-value activities.
  • Drive accountability across stakeholders and teams.

Client & Team Coordination

  • Act as a primary day-to-day operational contact for client teams.
  • Conduct structured weekly check-ins focused on progress, blockers, priorities, and outcomes.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on responsibilities and expectations.
  • Ensure communication remains clear, concise, and action-oriented.
  • Minimize friction between teams while maintaining accountability.

HR & People Operations

  • Support hiring processes, including CV screening and initial candidate evaluations.
  • Provide structured recommendations on candidate fit.
  • Assist with defining roles, responsibilities, and team structures.
  • Improve accountability through clear ownership and performance expectations.
  • Help clients align their people structure with operational requirements.

SOPs, Workflows & Process Development

  • Document recurring processes into clear SOPs, checklists, and workflows.
  • Identify inefficient or inconsistent processes and redesign them.
  • Build scalable operational systems that reduce dependency on individuals.
  • Apply structured project management frameworks, including PMP principles or equivalent methodologies.
  • Continuously improve processes based on operational performance and recurring issues.

AI & Automation

  • Use AI tools to improve operational speed, research, documentation, and decision support.
  • Identify repetitive processes suitable for automation.
  • Implement practical workflows using automation platforms where appropriate.
  • Improve efficiency without unnecessarily overengineering systems.
  • Help clients adopt AI and automation in ways that produce measurable operational value.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of experience in Operations, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience managing multiple clients, projects, or workstreams simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of operations as a discipline — beyond basic task coordination.
  • Experience working in startups or other fast-paced business environments.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as:
    • Slack
    • WhatsApp
    • Google Workspace
    • Airtable or similar operational platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.

Must-Have Requirements — Non-Negotiable

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management certification.
  • Previous experience in HR, hiring, or people operations.
  • Strong systems and structured-thinking mindset.
  • Ability to quickly understand and improve operations across different businesses.
  • Ability to manage multiple client environments simultaneously.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation tools.
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, or other AI productivity tools.
  • Experience supporting B2B or service-based businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders or entrepreneurial leadership teams.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think in systems, frameworks, ownership, and outcomes rather than simply completing tasks.
  • You can enter an unfamiliar business and quickly understand how it operates.
  • You know how to turn messy processes into structured workflows.
  • You can manage several clients without losing visibility or accountability.
  • You know when to prioritize, delegate, automate, or push back.
  • You balance people management with operational discipline.
  • You’re comfortable making decisions and solving problems without constant oversight.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review priorities and deliverables across multiple client accounts.
  • Run structured client or team check-ins.
  • Identify bottlenecks and assign clear next steps.
  • Update project trackers and monitor deadlines.
  • Review team structures or support hiring decisions.
  • Build or improve an SOP for a recurring workflow.
  • Implement an automation to eliminate repetitive work.
  • Resolve operational issues before they escalate.
  • Provide clients with clear visibility into progress, priorities, and risks.

In short: you bring structure to complexity and ensure teams, systems, and priorities work together to produce consistent results.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Consistent on-time delivery across client accounts.
  • Reduction in operational bottlenecks and execution delays.
  • Clear visibility across projects, owners, deadlines, and priorities.
  • Improved team accountability and performance.
  • Strong quality of hiring support and candidate recommendations.
  • Successful implementation and adoption of SOPs.
  • Increased operational efficiency through process improvement and automation.
  • Strong client confidence in operational execution.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening Call
  • Operations & Problem-Solving Assessment
  • Final Interview with Client
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it — only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Operations Manager who combines structured project management, HR knowledge, systems thinking, and hands-on execution, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build scalable operations across multiple fast-moving businesses.

Who you are

You are an accomplished B2B SaaS Account Executive with a proven track record of consistently meeting or beating quota. You enjoy consultative selling, collaborating with internal teams, and building, maintaining and executing against your pipeline. You enjoy being the CEO of your own business and solving real healthcare challenges for clients. You listen first, are an adept question asker and enjoy creative problem solving, helping prospects visualize how our novel cloud based software platform and immersive content will align with their goals and objectives.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain an active sales pipeline to exceed quarterly sales targets
  • Develop expertise in BioDigital’s core technology and effectively communicate the value to clients and prospects
  • Help clients articulate problems and identify both repeatable and creative opportunities for application to meet prospective clients’ goals
  • Identify market trends and help to design and execute sales plans that meet BioDigital’s short-term targets and long-term strategic goals
  • Maintain accurate sales pipeline and forecasts through Salesforce

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Tenacious approach to enterprise sales with demonstrated ability to create and execute against strategic sales plans
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strategic thinker with a creative problem-solving attitude
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Experience working in the health industry and/or with SaaS products strongly preferred
  • Proficiency with client qualification and discovery; willingness to invest the time to understand customers’ problems and find ways to map BioDigital’s solutions to their needs
  • Ability to learn from mistakes and apply lessons toward more effective problem solving in the future
  • 6-10 years sales experience
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time for internal meetings, client meetings, trade shows and events
The salary range for this position is $115,000 - 130,000 base per year, with on target variable compensation around $100,000. Variable compensation is uncapped and is based on a percentage payout of closed new bookings. raw.description:
Serving public sector customers is an integral part of ServiceNow's business and future growth trajectory. ServiceNow is a leading provider of digital workflows for many federal, state, and local government agencies in the United States. To help these organizations successfully fulfill their missions and deliver better experiences to citizens and constituents, ServiceNow provides specialized cloud environments that meet and exceed the data and security regulations and policies of our government customers. These environments span ServiceNow-hosted regulated clouds, customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, and emerging sovereign offerings.

About the role

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own strategy and execution across our U.S. Public Sector cloud platforms — a portfolio that includes our regulated ServiceNow-hosted environments (e.g., GCC and NSC), our self-hosted and partner-operated Private Stack deployments.

In this senior individual-contributor role you will define how the ServiceNow platform operates across isolated, customer-managed, and partner-hosted environments, setting cross-domain strategy and driving parity with our commercial cloud while meeting stringent compliance, security, and sovereignty requirements. You will shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, own multi-quarter strategy and roadmap, and directly influence the roadmap of the broader ServiceNow Platform to better serve this specialized segment of customers.

You will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, compliance, and go-to-market, leading multi-team and multi-VP programs and aligning engineering, security, GTM, legal, and partner ecosystems. Reporting into the Regulated Markets & Public Sector product organization, you will be a key member of a team that drives the growth of ServiceNow's public sector business.

Your product portfolio

  • Regulated ServiceNow-hosted clouds — Own strategy and roadmap for offerings (e.g., GCC, NSC) supporting U.S. federal, state, local, and other regulated public sector customers, aligned to frameworks such as FedRAMP, DoD IL4/IL5, CJIS, and FIPS.
  • Self-hosted / Private Stack (incl. Private Stack Pro) — Own strategy for customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, driving the containerized, scalable Private Stack Pro deployment model and the official Private Stack go-to-market.
  • Pro & sovereign offerings — Own roadmap, packaging, and GTM strategy for Pro hosted deployments and emerging sovereign asks, including new-market entry evaluation.
  • Partner & ecosystem model — Define how partners deliver ServiceNow as a regulated and sovereign platform, setting operating models, certification approaches, and GTM strategy.

What you get to do in this role

  • Own cross-domain product strategy and a multi-quarter roadmap across the U.S. public sector cloud portfolio, balancing parity, compliance-driven capabilities, and platform scalability across offerings.
  • Shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, anticipating parity blockers and validating federal, DoD, and SLED nuances (e.g., ATO, boundary, connectivity).
  • Define scalable compliance and security patterns (e.g., pre-authorization guardrails) with legal, compliance, OCISO, and security teams, anticipating NIST/TLS/CMMC deltas and de-risking early.
  • Partner with engineering to set architecture direction across deployment models (ServiceNow-hosted, customer-managed, partner-hosted, disconnected/air-gapped), containerization, and security, identity, and connectivity approaches.
  • Industrialize release patterns for regulated GA — planning SCR bundles, aligning QE/SRE gates, resolving cross-team blockers, and implementing operational metrics (lead time, change-fail rate).
  • Lead multi-team and multi-VP programs, influencing OCISO, legal, and infrastructure leadership to unblock delivery and align on strategy.
  • Design GTM motions with Legal and enable the field — positioning, FAQs, RFP responses, architecture guidance, and playbooks — to reduce sales friction across Private Stack, Pro, and sovereign offerings.
  • Own data-driven prioritization: balance capacity, cost, and revenue with scenario planning; tie investment to NNACV; and drive business cases and New Market Entry analysis tied to TAM and CACV.
  • Standardize specification and communication templates across the organization and set the documentation bar for regulated offerings; monitor competitive intelligence as an input into product strategy.
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 5+ years of B2B product management experience in platform or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with enterprise software, cloud architectures, or deployment platforms (familiarity with SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS models).
  • Proven ability to set strategy and lead cross-functional, multi-team initiatives in complex, ambiguous, and dynamic environments.
  • U.S. Citizenship and located within the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of sovereign cloud / regulated environments and self-hosted or customer-managed deployments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, CJIS, IL4/IL5, NIST, and FIPS.
  • Experience with Kubernetes / containerization strategies and partner ecosystem models (MSP, sovereign operators).
  • Experience working with the U.S. federal government and broader public sector.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-alignment skills, with a premium for precision and clarity of language.

Additional information

ServiceNow is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Customer Success Executive to support new and existing customers within our Strategic segment, ensuring their needs are met and that Carrot becomes a valued, ongoing part of their benefits offering.

You'll work closely with our customers to promote retention, boost member engagement, and uphold excellent customer satisfaction. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to HR benefits leaders, clearly communicate the value of Carrot's offerings, and respond proactively to customer questions and requests.

As a Customer Success Executive at Carrot, you will contribute to developing customer success approaches and best practices for supporting our key accounts, while playing a vital role in the growth and collaboration of our Customer Success team.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to HR benefits leaders
  • Drive retention and renewal outcomes across your book of business, proactively identifying risks and building action plans to address them
  • Increase member engagement and program utilization through data-informed recommendations and a regular cadence of business reviews
  • Communicate the value of Carrot's offerings through clear storytelling, reporting, and executive-ready presentations
  • Partner cross-functionally with Implementation, Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal & Compliance, and Member Success to deliver a seamless customer experience
  • Identify and support expansion opportunities within existing accounts in partnership with Sales
  • Contribute to customer success strategies, playbooks, and best practices that scale across the Strategic segment

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Built trusted, multi-threaded relationships across your portfolio, reflected in strong customer satisfaction and account health
  • Delivered consistent retention and renewal results across your book of business
  • Increased member engagement and program utilization across your accounts through proactive, data-informed recommendations
  • Established a regular cadence of business reviews that clearly communicate value and outcomes to customer stakeholders
  • Contributed at least one scalable playbook, process improvement, or best practice adopted by the broader Customer Success team

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's degree
  • 6+ years of professional experience working closely with external customers and partners in a Customer Success Management, Customer Onboarding/Implementation, or Project Management role with enterprise-sized customers (10,000+ covered lives) in the benefits space
  • A track record of successfully managing complex projects, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and meeting deadlines across multiple simultaneous workstreams
  • Clear, empathetic communication skills, with the ability to weigh customer needs and constraints against internal priorities
  • Enthusiasm for Carrot's mission and eagerness to become part of a collaborative, friendly, and dynamic team

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM, managing tasks efficiently in a dynamic environment
  • Familiarity with Carrot's buyers (HR benefits leaders)
  • Strong analytical, writing, and communication skills with sharp attention to detail
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity; highly organized, diligent, and self-motivated
  • A process-minded approach, with experience building scalable systems, improving efficiency, and automating routine work
  • A continuous improvement mindset and a habit of creating moments of delight for customers and colleagues

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Carrot's Strategic customers represent some of the company's largest and most complex relationships, and their success directly shapes retention, revenue, and Carrot's reputation in the market. The Customer Success Executive is the steward of these relationships, translating Carrot's clinical program and platform into measurable value for employers and their members.

Every renewed partnership and every increase in member engagement means more people can access fertility and family-building care. This role sits at the center of that impact, connecting customer outcomes to Carrot's mission of providing care for everyone, everywhere.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation 💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $110,000-$130,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Vendor Management Program Manager to lead the execution of our third-party risk management framework. This role is the backbone of our vendor oversight, ensuring that every partnership—from non-critical services to complex bank integrations—aligns with our high standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. You will have the authority to manage the vendor lifecycle and ensure our program remains robust under regulatory scrutiny.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $5,000 - $6,500 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:

  • Standards & Governance: work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, and Compliance teams to establish and maintain third-party risk standards and governance practices.
  • Due Diligence & Monitoring: Conduct comprehensive vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring activities, including evaluating consumer-impact risk, complaint analysis, and confirming privacy and data protection standards.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Manage third-party risk documentation and reporting, including maintaining the vendor and data processor inventory, ensuring timely onboarding and offboarding due diligence, and executing periodic compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment: Execute day-to-day risk assessments to determine vendor criticality and identify inherent risks in categories such as PII handling, BSA/AML, and credit decisioning.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Legal to ensure effective contracts are in place and with Information Security to validate the technical safeguards of our third-party partners.
  • Issue Escalation: Identify, track, and escalate risk events or performance failures to senior leadership and bank partners through established issue-tracking systems.

What We Look For:

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in vendor risk management, procurement, or third-party compliance, preferably within the fintech or regulated financial services industry.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of third-party risk management lifecycle and regulatory guidance (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GLBA, and BSA/AML).
  • Execution: Proven track record of managing a high volume of vendor assessments and maintaining a state of "audit-readiness" for bank partners and regulators.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Principal AI Engineering Architect, you will be tasked with leading the development and deployment of SentinelOne's next-generation AI-powered cybersecurity solutions. This critical role will shape SentinelOne's competitive advantage by translating cutting-edge AI research into production-grade, globally scalable products that proactively stay ahead of cybercriminals and tomorrow's threats. You will drive the strategy and execution for our core AI platforms, directly impacting our ability to deliver industry-leading protection to our customers.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Define and execute the technical roadmap for AI engineering, focusing on bringing the most recent advances in machine learning technology to help our customers efficiently discover and defeat threats.
  • Represent AI Engineering as a key contributor to the Architecture Board defining the overall architecture strategy for the SentinelOne Platform and Services.
  • Understand and define strategies to support cross domain requirements to use AI Platform and Services across SentinelOne.
  • Serve as a lead individual contributor who also mentors across distributed teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous innovation.
  • Design and build net-new AI capabilities to be used across SentinelOne's industry-leading cybersecurity platform.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across multiple engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and innovation in AI-powered cybersecurity products.
  • Oversee the establishment of best practices for MLOps, security, and performance monitoring to ensure the reliability and efficacy of our AI defense mechanisms.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 15 or more years of progressive experience in software or machine learning engineering.
  • Proven track record of delivering multiple high-scale, production-ready AI or data products from concept through deployment and maintenance.
  • Deep expertise in building highly available, low-latency machine learning systems, including experience with machine learning workflows and processes.
  • Experience in endpoint security, OS concepts, or a related field with comparable large-scale event processing and real-time processing challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, develop, and retain top-tier AI engineering talent.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Python and modern frameworks (e.g., Pydantic), cloud-native MLOps platforms (e.g., Kubeflow), and large-scale data processing technologies, including hands-on familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and operating in cloud environments, especially AWS and Google Cloud.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

As an LLM Application Engineer, you will build the intelligence layer that powers A1's AI experiences.

You will work at the intersection of LLMs, software engineering, and product - designing agent workflows, improving model behaviour, and turning AI capabilities into reliable user experiences.

You will own problems end-to-end, from understanding user needs, designing Agentic workflows, integrating models and tools, building evaluation system and continuously improving AI behaviour in production.

Focus

  • Build and ship LLM-powered applications and AI agent workflows

  • Design systems for reasoning, planning, memory, tool uuse and multi-step execution

  • Build reliable orchestration pipelines that turn probabilistic model outputs into predictable, observable, and safe actions

  • Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, search, internal services, and external tools.

  • Develop prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, and other techniques to improve model behaviour

  • Build evaluation frameworks and datasets to measure AI quality, reliability, and regressions

  • Debug AI systems across the entire stack—from model behaviour and prompts to orchestration, backend services, and product UX

  • Optimise AI systems for quality, latency, and cost

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to turn ambiguous product problems into working AI solutions

  • Establish production practices for observability, tracing, experimentation, evaluation, and continuous improvement

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • LLM APIs and model providers, including OpenAI-compatible APIs and open-weight models

  • Agent frameworks and orchestration systems

  • Vector databases and retrieval systems

  • Backend services, APIs, and distributed systems

  • PyTorch / JAX

Ideal Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building AI-powered applications

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, generative AI, or agent-based systems

  • Experience designing prompts, workflows, evaluations, or AI behaviour

  • Ability to write clean, production-quality code

  • Comfortable working across abstraction layers (model → system → product)

  • Strong problem-solving skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement

Outcomes

  • AI features reach production quickly and deliver measurable user impact

  • LLM-powered workflows are reliable, scalable, observable, and maintainable

  • AI quality improves through systematic evaluation, experimentation, and iteration

  • AI workflows become increasingly predictable, efficient, and cost-effective

  • Complex AI capabilities are translated into simple, intuitive user experiences

Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our BizOps & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a BizOps team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more BizOps team members. We are hiring 4-6 people to drive impact in these areas:

  • Growth Marketing

  • Product Development

  • AI & Automation

  • Strategic Partnerships

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • No corporate fluff: The BizOps & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central BizOps & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

  • Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

  • Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

  • Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

  • First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with Excel, SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

raw.description:
About Command|Link

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a 100% remote position

About your new role:

Command|Alert is CommandLink's signal-processing core: the engine that turns raw security, monitoring, and customer-defined telemetry into alerts customers actually trust. Alert fatigue and noise are the top complaint across every competitor in this space, and this role exists to make sure our alerts are the ones people don't tune out.

As a Staff Software Engineer on Command|Alert, you'll operate across the two to three teams that touch alerting, from rule evaluation and anomaly detection through delivery and downstream notification. You'll drive the org's most consequential decisions on how the correlation and alerting engine is architected, dive into whichever team or project needs your depth, and balance near-term reliability work with the long-term technical foundation the product is built on.

This is a role for someone who reasons fluently across data: taking in security tooling, monitoring telemetry, syslog, OpenTelemetry, and L2-L4 network protocols, deriving real network and system topologies and the dependencies between them, and using that context to make LLM-driven reasoning over correctness, troubleshooting, and remediation actually work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set the architecture for how Command|Alert evaluates rule-based thresholds, ML anomaly scores, and correlation logic to produce high-fidelity alerts, across both global alerts we define and alerts customers define themselves.
  • Own the reliability of the alerting pipeline end to end: from OpenSearch alert evaluation through Kafka delivery via OpenSearch callbacks to downstream notification, including idempotency guarantees and soak-tested behavior under sustained load.
  • Drive the correlation strategy that turns diverse sources (security tooling, monitoring telemetry, syslog, OpenTelemetry, L2-L4 network protocols) into usable network and system topologies and their dependencies, and make that context usable for LLM reasoning over investigations and remediation.
  • Lay the technical groundwork for generating alert definitions from the normalized data model using LLMs.
  • Jump into any team or workstream across Command|Alert that needs architectural guidance, unblocking others and raising the bar on how the system is built.
  • Balance strategic bets (new correlation and detection capability) against the long-term foundation the alerting engine needs to hold up at scale.
  • Mentor engineers across the teams you touch, and represent Command|Alert's technical direction to stakeholders outside engineering.
  • Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

What you'll need for success:

Required

  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, or operating high-reliability alerting or notification systems in production, including running rule-based and ML-based detection logic against real traffic at scale.
  • Strong Kafka experience, particularly producing and consuming event streams for downstream delivery.
  • A working command of telemetry and protocol data: security tooling output, monitoring telemetry, syslog, OpenTelemetry, NetFlow or sFlow, SNMP, ICMP, and firewall logs, and the ability to turn that data into real network and system topologies and dependency maps.
  • A track record building or operating systems where webhook reliability, idempotency, and delivery guarantees under load are non-negotiable.
  • Recognized mastery of Go and/or Python, with range across container orchestration and a multi-cloud footprint.
  • A demonstrated ability to make org-level architecture and technology calls, not just execute within one.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Temporal or a comparable workflow orchestration platform.
  • Experience using LLMs to reason over structured system or network data for troubleshooting, remediation, or investigation workflows.
  • Familiarity with stream processing frameworks like Flink, Protocol Buffers for service contracts, or Argo and Spacelift for CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
  • Familiarity with Memgraph or another graph store for topology data.
  • Background with osquery, Steampipe, or similar endpoint and cloud inventory tooling.
  • Experience operating in a multi-tenant, cloud-native environment with secrets management and TLS at scale

Why you'll love life at Command|Link

Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

  • Room to grow at a high-growth company
  • An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
  • Your work will have a tangible impact
  • Flexible time off
  • Fun events at cool locations

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

About the Job

Run the operating rhythm

  • Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.
  • Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.
  • Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.
  • Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).
  • Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).
  • Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.
  • Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.
  • Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

Plan executive communication

  • Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.
  • Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health

  • Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.
  • Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.
  • Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

Drive priority programs

  • Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.
  • Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.
  • Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of work experience
  • R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization
  • Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives
  • Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.
  • High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level
  • Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.
  • Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.
  • Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.
  • Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

You will work at the intersection of LLMs, software engineering, and product - designing agent workflows, improving model behaviour, and turning AI capabilities into reliable user experiences.

• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit.

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level.

What you’ll do:

  • Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes.
