Job Summary

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coder-Interventional Cardiology is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. This role ensures proper sequencing, modifier use, and place-of-service coding in compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate standards. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

  • Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).
  • Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.
  • Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.
  • Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.
  • Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.
  • Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.
  • Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required
  • Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.
  • Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR), coding software, and claim processing systems.
  • Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and escalate for provider education.
  • Familiarity with NCCI edits, LCD/NCD guidelines, and medical necessity requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ensuring accurate coding and optimal reimbursement.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, working with providers, revenue cycle teams, and compliance staff.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC (CPC) required or
  • CCS-Certified Coding Specialist (CCS-P) required
  • Additional certifications such as Certified Evaluation and Management Coder (CEMC) or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) preferred

raw.description:
The Marketing Manager builds and runs the target account program for software vendors. The role decides which vendors Software Finder pursues, develops enough understanding of each vendor business to build a credible commercial case, and designs personalized campaigns that convert priority accounts into qualified meetings and activated programs.

This is a hands-on role positioned between marketing and business development. Research matters only when it leads to a clear commercial action, and performance is judged on meetings, opportunities and revenue rather than campaign volume.

Key responsibilities

Target account strategy and selection

  • Own the account-based marketing strategy for vendors most likely to invest in our offerings.

  • Prioritize accounts on revenue potential, category fit, demand generation maturity and likelihood of conversion.

  • Maintain an account scoring model covering category fit, commercial potential, vendor maturity, competitive activity, relationship strength, product fit and timing signals such as new funding, product launches, hiring or category expansion.

  • Classify accounts into strategic, growth and programmatic tiers, and set the level of personalization and investment each tier receives. Depth of personalization must reflect account value rather than being applied evenly.

  • Review the account list on an ongoing basis, removing or downgrading accounts that show weak fit or limited commercial potential.

Account research and intelligence

  • Research each priority vendor: products, software categories, target market, competitors, paid search presence, marketplace visibility, current campaigns and likely demand generation priorities.

  • Map buying committees across demand generation, performance marketing, account-based marketing, product marketing, growth, partnerships and senior marketing leadership.

  • Develop a clear commercial hypothesis for every strategic account: why the vendor should work with Software Finder, which product is the right entry point and what evidence will be required to win.

  • Maintain a standard account research and account brief format so research stays consistent and reusable.

Positioning and campaign design

  • Ensure that the messaging used for each vendor category, market position aligns with current acquisition strategy and likely business challenges/outcomes.

  • Design one to one, one to few and one to many campaigns for priority vendors and categories.

  • Group similar vendors into repeatable category plays across verticals such as HR and payroll, medical, ERP, construction, CMMS and legal technology.

  • Build a competitive entry strategy for vendors already investing in similar products.

Campaign execution

  • Coordinate personalized email, LinkedIn, content, paid advertising, webinars, direct outreach, executive engagement and event-based campaigns.

  • Create or commission account specific content including account briefs, landing pages, presentations, category opportunity reports, benchmarking, ROI scenarios and outreach messages.

  • Identify accounts where CEO, founder or senior leadership involvement improves access or credibility, and prepare those executives with the right context and message.

  • Run opportunity acceleration campaigns for priority accounts already in the pipeline, addressing objections, engaging additional stakeholders or restarting stalled conversations.

Business development enablement

  • Provide business development with an actionable account brief covering stakeholder maps, engagement history, recommended product, talking points, likely objections, suggested responses, next best action and estimated commercial potential.

  • Orchestrate marketing and business development touches so target accounts receive one coherent message rather than disconnected communications.

  • Run a regular target account review with business development and maintain clear agreement on account ownership, outreach coordination and follow up.

Event based account marketing

  • Own the target account motion around each selected event. Product Marketing retains ownership of overall event selection and planning.

  • Identify priority accounts and decision makers expected to attend, research speakers, sponsors and exhibitors, and rank accounts by meeting priority.

  • Run personalized pre-event outreach, coordinate business development and leadership involvement, and secure meetings before travel rather than relying on unplanned networking.

  • Prepare briefs for attendees, track onsite engagement and next steps, and coordinate account specific post event campaigns.

Measurement, market feedback and budget

  • Track visits, content interaction, email engagement, event activity, meetings and other buying signals at the account level.

  • Work with Marketing Operations to maintain reporting on target account coverage, account engagement, meeting and pipeline performance, account progression through to realized revenue, and play performance by category, product, message, channel and event.

  • Capture and circulate account level market feedback: objections, competitive intelligence, product requests and the reasons accounts engage or decline.

  • Determine which account segments, messages, products, channels and personalization levels produce the best commercial results.

  • Recommend and manage account-based marketing spend against engagement, qualified meetings, opportunities, activations and realized revenue.

Experience and skills required

  • 5 to 7 years in B2B marketing, including at least two years in account-based marketing, demand generation or field marketing.

  • A track record of target account programs that produced qualified meetings and pipeline, not only engagement metrics.

  • Strong research ability. Able to read a company website, ad presence and market position and form a commercial view quickly.

  • Commercial judgment about where to concentrate effort, including which accounts justify deep personalization and which do not.

  • Confident writing personalized outreach, account briefs and commercial narratives in clear English.

  • Comfortable working closely with sales and being measured on pipeline.

  • Hands on experience with CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot, plus LinkedIn campaign tools.

  • Bachelor degree in marketing, business or a related field.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing to software or SaaS vendors.

  • Familiarity with software marketplaces and review platforms.

  • Experience running event-led account campaigns.

  • Exposure to intent data and account engagement scoring.

About the company

iSpeedToLead runs a real estate lead marketplace focused on motivated home-seller leads for investors, wholesalers, and operators. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: they see key details before they buy, with transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. The JV program places unsold motivated seller leads with real estate operators who have the teams, follow-up systems, and closing ability to convert them into revenue.

Role overview

The JV Partnership Manager owns who gets into the JV program, how they perform, and whether they stay. You will recruit and close new JV partners, onboard them properly, coach them to perform, hold them accountable, retain the ones worth keeping, and grow their value over time. You are not here to collect signups - you are here to build a partner base that produces revenue consistently and grows month over month.

Responsibilities

  • Recruit, qualify, and close high-quality JV partners who have real acquisition teams and real closing ability

  • Onboard new partners properly: set expectations early, drive activation fast, and prevent stalling

  • Coach partners directly on follow-up, lead handling, prioritization, and pipeline execution

  • Organize monthly partner meetings, performance reviews, and accountability check-ins

  • Retain strong partners through results, not just relationship maintenance

  • Identify upsell opportunities inside the existing partner base and act on them

  • Catch disengagement and performance drops early, not after a partner has already mentally quit

  • Analyze why top partners outperform and push lower performers to close the gap

  • Protect the quality of the partner base by filtering out weak operators before they waste lead flow

  • Build repeatable systems for recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and growing JV partners

  • Work cross-functionally to make sure partners are supported, integrated, and operationally set up


Requirements

  • 2+ years in partner recruitment, affiliate management, business development, or any role where you recruited, closed, and managed external revenue-generating relationships

  • Proven ability to sell a partnership, set expectations, and hold partners to them

  • Experience coaching or managing external partners on execution and performance, not just maintaining relationships

  • Strong enough commercially to spot the difference between a serious operator and someone who interviews well but will not perform

  • Comfortable managing 30+ active partner relationships without losing control of any of them

  • Organized, responsive, and high-accountability - you follow up before anyone asks you to

  • Clear written and verbal English

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where outcomes matter more than activity


Nice to have

  • Experience in real estate investing, wholesaling, or lead generation

  • Background in JV structuring, affiliate programs, or revenue-share partnerships

  • Experience building a partner channel from early stage or scaling an existing one

  • Familiarity with CRM tools, lead management platforms, and performance tracking systems


What we offer

  • A role with real ownership over a revenue channel that directly impacts company growth

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based compensation - your results are visible and rewarded

  • A lean, fast-moving team where operators thrive and bureaucracy does not exist

  • Remote flexibility

  • A company that treats JV partnerships as a core growth engine, not a side project

description: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.

raw.title: Investment Lead
raw.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

This role is on the Intercept team, which is part of Stripe's broader collection of public goods initiatives, including Frontier.

Respiratory viruses kill 1 million people a year, cost us $600B annually, disrupt everyday life, and periodically threaten civilization. Recent breakthroughs may make it possible to develop and deploy broad-spectrum preventatives and air cleaning technologies that defend against common respiratory infections. Intercept is a $500M philanthropic initiative that aims to radically reduce the burden of respiratory infections, and eventually eliminate them altogether. Learn more about Intercept via our launch post and our website

What you’ll do

Intercept is looking for an experienced biotech/biohealth investor to join our team.

We’re working to make sure the portfolio of technologies needed to radically reduce the burden of respiratory viruses exists. We have two main focus areas: air-cleaning technologies (ACT’s) and broad-spectrum preventatives (BSPs). For BSPs, our goal is to advance 2+ products that meet our target product profile through Phase 2. We make both grants and investments, using the most capital-efficient tool to advance our target product profile.

Initially, this role will be focused on building internal investment processes, investment thesis, and supporting Intercept in establishing the investment function. Ultimately this role will focus on sourcing, diligencing, and executing on pipeline opportunities to make equity and/or grant investments in companies that have the most promising BSPs against our target product profile (TPP). In addition, the role will be responsible for portfolio management to make sure portfolio projects successfully advance their products by helping to remove bottlenecks and accelerate timelines. To effectively accomplish this work, the Investment Lead will develop views on the most promising approaches, identify new cutting edge areas of science, understand key product development inflection points, including mapping key technical and clinical/regulatory bottlenecks and developing plans to de-risk / mitigate them.

We need someone who can go deep on scientific and development diligence while also zooming out to synthesize how findings impact our capital deployment plan and long-term goals. A successful candidate will be action-oriented and comfortable working independently (vs. waiting to be told what to do) and a great communicator who can translate complex science for diverse audiences.

Intercept is a small team; you'll work with the entire team, many partners, and wear many hats. You'll own specific outcomes end-to-end and have a chance to contribute to BSP strategy over time.

Responsibilities

  • Expand the pipeline of candidates. Proactively engage networks (researchers, investors, founders, funders, etc.) to source new ideas and technologies. Manage referral channels (open RFP, referrals, etc.) and screen investment and grant opportunities.
  • Own projects through diligence and transaction execution. Advance companies through early and deep / technical diligence: evaluating science quality, development plans, team, and fit against our TPP. Drive the investment or grantmaking process, coordinating with internal and external legal and diligence consultants. Bring projects through internal approval processes and act as the internal owner/champion.
  • Develop points of view on technologies. Contribute to publishing a POV for the 5-10 most promising approaches (i.e., siRNA, T-cell vaccine, innate immune stimulators) and identify the key 'gating datapoints' that would make us kill or double down on that approach and when we'll get that datapoint (or if there is a gap).
  • Build and maintain the CRM. Help ensure our CRM captures ~all known projects, and we have a process to systematically learn about/capture the best new projects early.
  • Portfolio management. Supporting portfolio projects and leading on efforts to accelerate and support projects post investmentDetermine what would let the top projects in the field move 2x faster beyond funding and make sure those things happen.
  • Map demand-side bottlenecks. Help map key stakeholders and address key evidence needs and bottlenecks across regulatory, clinical, recommendations, reimbursement and adoption/uptake.

Future opportunities for growth

  • Lead investments independently. Grow into a more senior team lead, owning deals from start to finish, managing investment teams, and generating / pursuing new investment theses.
  • Shape capital deployment. Contribute to our capital deployment plan informed by a clear POV of the most promising approaches.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • MD/PhD in immunology or infectious disease with 2+ years of investing, BD/partnering, or grantmaking experience or minimum 5 years of biotech investor experience in immunology or infectious disease at VC fund
  • Experience with portfolio management, including portfolio construction and post-award management
  • Ability to translate scientific diligence into strategic investment recommendations and a coherent capital deployment view
  • Product development experience (and/or broad exposure via investing in or supporting companies)
  • Experience with project management from launch to completion / project quarterback with a high openness to getting hands dirty
  • Extremely self-directed, diligent, very fast learner, excellent communicator, very action oriented (vs talking about things)
  • Compelled by our mission to greatly reduce the burden of and risks from respiratory viruses

Preferred qualifications

  • Public health / global health / biosecurity experience
  • MBA or MPH degrees
  • Experience with issuing non-dilutive funding / grant programs

raw.excerpt: Who we are About StripeStripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

This role is on the Intercept team, which is part of Stripe's broader collection of public goods initiatives, including Frontier.

Respiratory viruses kill 1 million people a year, cost us $600B annually, disrupt everyday life, and periodically threaten civilization. Recent breakthroughs may make it possible to develop and deploy broad-spectrum preventatives and air cleaning technologies that defend against common respiratory infections. Intercept is a $500M philanthropic initiative that aims to radically reduce the burden of respiratory infections, and eventually eliminate them altogether. Learn more about Intercept via our launch post and our website

What you’ll do

Intercept is looking for an experienced biotech/biohealth investor to join our team.

We’re working to make sure the portfolio of technologies needed to radically reduce the burden of respiratory viruses exists. We have two main focus areas: air-cleaning technologies (ACT’s) and broad-spectrum preventatives (BSPs). For BSPs, our goal is to advance 2+ products that meet our target product profile through Phase 2. We make both grants and investments, using the most capital-efficient tool to advance our target product profile.

Initially, this role will be focused on building internal investment processes, investment thesis, and supporting Intercept in establishing the investment function. Ultimately this role will focus on sourcing, diligencing, and executing on pipeline opportunities to make equity and/or grant investments in companies that have the most promising BSPs against our target product profile (TPP). In addition, the role will be responsible for portfolio management to make sure portfolio projects successfully advance their products by helping to remove bottlenecks and accelerate timelines. To effectively accomplish this work, the Investment Lead will develop views on the most promising approaches, identify new cutting edge areas of science, understand key product development inflection points, including mapping key technical and clinical/regulatory bottlenecks and developing plans to de-risk / mitigate them.

We need someone who can go deep on scientific and development diligence while also zooming out to synthesize how findings impact our capital deployment plan and long-term goals. A successful candidate will be action-oriented and comfortable working independently (vs. waiting to be told what to do) and a great communicator who can translate complex science for diverse audiences.

Intercept is a small team; you'll work with the entire team, many partners, and wear many hats. You'll own specific outcomes end-to-end and have a chance to contribute to BSP strategy over time.

Responsibilities

  • Expand the pipeline of candidates. Proactively engage networks (researchers, investors, founders, funders, etc.) to source new ideas and technologies. Manage referral channels (open RFP, referrals, etc.) and screen investment and grant opportunities.
  • Own projects through diligence and transaction execution. Advance companies through early and deep / technical diligence: evaluating science quality, development plans, team, and fit against our TPP. Drive the investment or grantmaking process, coordinating with internal and external legal and diligence consultants. Bring projects through internal approval processes and act as the internal owner/champion.
  • Develop points of view on technologies. Contribute to publishing a POV for the 5-10 most promising approaches (i.e., siRNA, T-cell vaccine, innate immune stimulators) and identify the key 'gating datapoints' that would make us kill or double down on that approach and when we'll get that datapoint (or if there is a gap).
  • Build and maintain the CRM. Help ensure our CRM captures ~all known projects, and we have a process to systematically learn about/capture the best new projects early.
  • Portfolio management. Supporting portfolio projects and leading on efforts to accelerate and support projects post investmentDetermine what would let the top projects in the field move 2x faster beyond funding and make sure those things happen.
  • Map demand-side bottlenecks. Help map key stakeholders and address key evidence needs and bottlenecks across regulatory, clinical, recommendations, reimbursement and adoption/uptake.

Future opportunities for growth

  • Lead investments independently. Grow into a more senior team lead, owning deals from start to finish, managing investment teams, and generating / pursuing new investment theses.
  • Shape capital deployment. Contribute to our capital deployment plan informed by a clear POV of the most promising approaches.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • MD/PhD in immunology or infectious disease with 2+ years of investing, BD/partnering, or grantmaking experience or minimum 5 years of biotech investor experience in immunology or infectious disease at VC fund
  • Experience with portfolio management, including portfolio construction and post-award management
  • Ability to translate scientific diligence into strategic investment recommendations and a coherent capital deployment view
  • Product development experience (and/or broad exposure via investing in or supporting companies)
  • Experience with project management from launch to completion / project quarterback with a high openness to getting hands dirty
  • Extremely self-directed, diligent, very fast learner, excellent communicator, very action oriented (vs talking about things)
  • Compelled by our mission to greatly reduce the burden of and risks from respiratory viruses

Preferred qualifications

  • Public health / global health / biosecurity experience
  • MBA or MPH degrees
  • Experience with issuing non-dilutive funding / grant programs

Operations Manager (Operations, HR & Project Management) – Remote | IST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: IST (GMT +5:30)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Operations Manager to bring structure, clarity, and execution discipline across multiple client environments.

This is a high-ownership, systems-driven role — not an administrative or coordination-only position. You’ll manage operations across multiple businesses simultaneously, identify operational gaps, build scalable processes, improve team accountability, and ensure priorities move from planning to execution.

The role sits at the intersection of Operations, Project Management, and HR, making it ideal for someone who understands both how businesses operate and how teams need to be structured to perform effectively.

What You’ll Own

Multi-Client Operations Management

  • Manage operations across multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • Quickly understand each client’s business model, priorities, workflows, and operational challenges.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous or fast-changing environments.
  • Establish clear priorities and maintain visibility across active workstreams.
  • Adapt operational frameworks to different businesses without creating unnecessary complexity.

Delivery & Execution Management

  • Maintain structured trackers for projects, deliverables, owners, and deadlines.
  • Ensure commitments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Identify bottlenecks before they affect delivery.
  • Proactively resolve execution gaps and escalate critical risks when necessary.
  • Prioritize high-impact initiatives while pushing back on low-value activities.
  • Drive accountability across stakeholders and teams.

Client & Team Coordination

  • Act as a primary day-to-day operational contact for client teams.
  • Conduct structured weekly check-ins focused on progress, blockers, priorities, and outcomes.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on responsibilities and expectations.
  • Ensure communication remains clear, concise, and action-oriented.
  • Minimize friction between teams while maintaining accountability.

HR & People Operations

  • Support hiring processes, including CV screening and initial candidate evaluations.
  • Provide structured recommendations on candidate fit.
  • Assist with defining roles, responsibilities, and team structures.
  • Improve accountability through clear ownership and performance expectations.
  • Help clients align their people structure with operational requirements.

SOPs, Workflows & Process Development

  • Document recurring processes into clear SOPs, checklists, and workflows.
  • Identify inefficient or inconsistent processes and redesign them.
  • Build scalable operational systems that reduce dependency on individuals.
  • Apply structured project management frameworks, including PMP principles or equivalent methodologies.
  • Continuously improve processes based on operational performance and recurring issues.

AI & Automation

  • Use AI tools to improve operational speed, research, documentation, and decision support.
  • Identify repetitive processes suitable for automation.
  • Implement practical workflows using automation platforms where appropriate.
  • Improve efficiency without unnecessarily overengineering systems.
  • Help clients adopt AI and automation in ways that produce measurable operational value.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of experience in Operations, Project Management, Chief of Staff, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience managing multiple clients, projects, or workstreams simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of operations as a discipline — beyond basic task coordination.
  • Experience working in startups or other fast-paced business environments.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as:
    • Slack
    • WhatsApp
    • Google Workspace
    • Airtable or similar operational platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.

Must-Have Requirements — Non-Negotiable

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management certification.
  • Previous experience in HR, hiring, or people operations.
  • Strong systems and structured-thinking mindset.
  • Ability to quickly understand and improve operations across different businesses.
  • Ability to manage multiple client environments simultaneously.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar automation tools.
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, or other AI productivity tools.
  • Experience supporting B2B or service-based businesses.
  • Experience working directly with founders or entrepreneurial leadership teams.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think in systems, frameworks, ownership, and outcomes rather than simply completing tasks.
  • You can enter an unfamiliar business and quickly understand how it operates.
  • You know how to turn messy processes into structured workflows.
  • You can manage several clients without losing visibility or accountability.
  • You know when to prioritize, delegate, automate, or push back.
  • You balance people management with operational discipline.
  • You’re comfortable making decisions and solving problems without constant oversight.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review priorities and deliverables across multiple client accounts.
  • Run structured client or team check-ins.
  • Identify bottlenecks and assign clear next steps.
  • Update project trackers and monitor deadlines.
  • Review team structures or support hiring decisions.
  • Build or improve an SOP for a recurring workflow.
  • Implement an automation to eliminate repetitive work.
  • Resolve operational issues before they escalate.
  • Provide clients with clear visibility into progress, priorities, and risks.

In short: you bring structure to complexity and ensure teams, systems, and priorities work together to produce consistent results.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Consistent on-time delivery across client accounts.
  • Reduction in operational bottlenecks and execution delays.
  • Clear visibility across projects, owners, deadlines, and priorities.
  • Improved team accountability and performance.
  • Strong quality of hiring support and candidate recommendations.
  • Successful implementation and adoption of SOPs.
  • Increased operational efficiency through process improvement and automation.
  • Strong client confidence in operational execution.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening Call
  • Operations & Problem-Solving Assessment
  • Final Interview with Client
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it — only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Operations Manager who combines structured project management, HR knowledge, systems thinking, and hands-on execution, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build scalable operations across multiple fast-moving businesses.

BioDigital, a Division of Anatomage, has built the first cloud platform for visualizing the human body in interactive 3D. Similar to Google Earth, but for the human body, our cutting edge technology is used on a global scale by patients and professionals who need a more engaging, visual format for learning about health and medicine. Our unique team is leveraging this work to achieve our mission of powering every health conversation in the world and we are seeking a talented Senior Account Executive to help us achieve our ambitious growth goals.

Who you are

You are an accomplished B2B SaaS Account Executive with a proven track record of consistently meeting or beating quota. You enjoy consultative selling, collaborating with internal teams, and building, maintaining and executing against your pipeline. You enjoy being the CEO of your own business and solving real healthcare challenges for clients. You listen first, are an adept question asker and enjoy creative problem solving, helping prospects visualize how our novel cloud based software platform and immersive content will align with their goals and objectives.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain an active sales pipeline to exceed quarterly sales targets
  • Develop expertise in BioDigital’s core technology and effectively communicate the value to clients and prospects
  • Help clients articulate problems and identify both repeatable and creative opportunities for application to meet prospective clients’ goals
  • Identify market trends and help to design and execute sales plans that meet BioDigital’s short-term targets and long-term strategic goals

What you’ll bring to the role

raw.description:
Serving public sector customers is an integral part of ServiceNow's business and future growth trajectory. ServiceNow is a leading provider of digital workflows for many federal, state, and local government agencies in the United States. To help these organizations successfully fulfill their missions and deliver better experiences to citizens and constituents, ServiceNow provides specialized cloud environments that meet and exceed the data and security regulations and policies of our government customers. These environments span ServiceNow-hosted regulated clouds, customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, and emerging sovereign offerings.

About the role

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own strategy and execution across our U.S. Public Sector cloud platforms — a portfolio that includes our regulated ServiceNow-hosted environments (e.g., GCC and NSC), our self-hosted and partner-operated Private Stack deployments.

In this senior individual-contributor role you will define how the ServiceNow platform operates across isolated, customer-managed, and partner-hosted environments, setting cross-domain strategy and driving parity with our commercial cloud while meeting stringent compliance, security, and sovereignty requirements. You will shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, own multi-quarter strategy and roadmap, and directly influence the roadmap of the broader ServiceNow Platform to better serve this specialized segment of customers.

You will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, compliance, and go-to-market, leading multi-team and multi-VP programs and aligning engineering, security, GTM, legal, and partner ecosystems. Reporting into the Regulated Markets & Public Sector product organization, you will be a key member of a team that drives the growth of ServiceNow's public sector business.

Your product portfolio

  • Regulated ServiceNow-hosted clouds — Own strategy and roadmap for offerings (e.g., GCC, NSC) supporting U.S. federal, state, local, and other regulated public sector customers, aligned to frameworks such as FedRAMP, DoD IL4/IL5, CJIS, and FIPS.
  • Self-hosted / Private Stack (incl. Private Stack Pro) — Own strategy for customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, driving the containerized, scalable Private Stack Pro deployment model and the official Private Stack go-to-market.
  • Pro & sovereign offerings — Own roadmap, packaging, and GTM strategy for Pro hosted deployments and emerging sovereign asks, including new-market entry evaluation.
  • Partner & ecosystem model — Define how partners deliver ServiceNow as a regulated and sovereign platform, setting operating models, certification approaches, and GTM strategy.

What you get to do in this role

  • Own cross-domain product strategy and a multi-quarter roadmap across the U.S. public sector cloud portfolio, balancing parity, compliance-driven capabilities, and platform scalability across offerings.
  • Shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, anticipating parity blockers and validating federal, DoD, and SLED nuances (e.g., ATO, boundary, connectivity).
  • Define scalable compliance and security patterns (e.g., pre-authorization guardrails) with legal, compliance, OCISO, and security teams, anticipating NIST/TLS/CMMC deltas and de-risking early.
  • Partner with engineering to set architecture direction across deployment models (ServiceNow-hosted, customer-managed, partner-hosted, disconnected/air-gapped), containerization, and security, identity, and connectivity approaches.
  • Industrialize release patterns for regulated GA — planning SCR bundles, aligning QE/SRE gates, resolving cross-team blockers, and implementing operational metrics (lead time, change-fail rate).
  • Lead multi-team and multi-VP programs, influencing OCISO, legal, and infrastructure leadership to unblock delivery and align on strategy.
  • Design GTM motions with Legal and enable the field — positioning, FAQs, RFP responses, architecture guidance, and playbooks — to reduce sales friction across Private Stack, Pro, and sovereign offerings.
  • Own data-driven prioritization: balance capacity, cost, and revenue with scenario planning; tie investment to NNACV; and drive business cases and New Market Entry analysis tied to TAM and CACV.
  • Standardize specification and communication templates across the organization and set the documentation bar for regulated offerings; monitor competitive intelligence as an input into product strategy.
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 5+ years of B2B product management experience in platform or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with enterprise software, cloud architectures, or deployment platforms (familiarity with SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS models).
  • Proven ability to set strategy and lead cross-functional, multi-team initiatives in complex, ambiguous, and dynamic environments.
  • U.S. Citizenship and located within the United States.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of sovereign cloud / regulated environments and self-hosted or customer-managed deployments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, CJIS, IL4/IL5, NIST, and FIPS.
  • Experience with Kubernetes / containerization strategies and partner ecosystem models (MSP, sovereign operators).
  • Experience working with the U.S. federal government and broader public sector.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-alignment skills, with a premium for precision and clarity of language.

Additional information

ServiceNow is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $143,200-$243,400, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

About Bask & Lather Co.

Bask & Lather Co. is one of the fastest-growing hair care brands, dedicated to helping people achieve healthier hair through scalp-first innovation. Our products are trusted by millions of customers across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop,
, and other digital marketplaces. As we continue to scale rapidly, we're looking for exceptional talent who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is passionate about using data to create outstanding customer experiences.


Position Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical, customer-obsessed Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager to own and continuously improve the digital shopping experience across Bask & Lather's ecommerce ecosystem.

This role is responsible for maximizing website conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, and overall customer experience through data-driven experimentation, user experience optimization, merchandising improvements, and customer behavior analysis.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with consumer psychology, UX best practices, and ecommerce expertise. Success in this role will be measured by measurable revenue growth, not simply the number of tests launched.

This is a highly visible role that partners closely with the Director of Ecommerce, Head of Growth, Marketing, Creative, Development, and Lifecycle Marketing teams to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and execute experiments that drive meaningful business results.

Own Bask & Lather's CRO Strategy

Identify:

Ecommerce Merchandising

Optimize:

Landing Page Optimization

Own the optimization of landing pages supporting:


  • Paid media
  • Influencer campaigns
  • Product launches
  • Promotional campaigns
  • Seasonal events
  • Retail launches
Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:


  • Director of Ecommerce
  • Founder & CEO
  • Ecommerce Manager
  • Brand Marketing
  • Lifecycle Marketing
  • Creative Team
  • Development Team
  • Customer Experience
  • Operations
Reporting & Performance Measurement

Develop executive dashboards and provide weekly reporting on:


  • Conversion rate trends
  • Revenue per visitor
  • A/B test results
  • Revenue generated from experiments
  • Customer behavior insights
  • Key learnings
  • Next optimization priorities
Qualifications


Required



  • 4+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization for a high-growth DTC ecommerce brand.
  • Deep experience with Shopify Plus.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce analytics.
  • Experience planning and executing A/B testing programs.
  • Experience with GA4, Shopify Analytics, and customer behavior tools.
  • Strong understanding of UX principles and consumer psychology.
  • Proven ability to increase conversion rate and revenue through experimentation.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong project management and prioritization abilities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred

Experience with:

  • Shoplift
  • VWO
  • Optimizely
  • Convert
  • Dynamic Yield
  • Rebuy
  • Klaviyo
  • Postscript
  • HTML/CSS fundamentals
  • SQL or advanced analytics

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Description

Required Certificates and Licenses

  • Appropriate state Department of Education Middle School (5-8) Science Teaching Certification Required

    • If the current Teaching Certification is from another state, candidate must provide proof of their New Mexico license application within 7 days of the start date AND must obtain an approved New Mexico teaching license within 90 days of the start date.

Residency Requirements

  • This position is remote and strongly prefer candidates that reside in New Mexico. May consider candidates that reside in the 50 states and Washington, D.C.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, New Mexico Destination Career Academy (NMDCA). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of New Mexico Destination Career Academy (NMDCA) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

The Middle School Science Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.

This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Provides rich and engaging synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences for students

  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students

  • Demonstrates a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations

  • Differentiates instruction based on student level of mastery

  • Augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools under guidance from principal and coach

  • Maintains grade book ensuring student academic integrity, makes student placement and promotion decisions, and alerts administrators to concerns about student performance and progress

  • Prepares students for high stakes standardized tests

  • Understands that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner

  • Supports learning coaches/parents with student curricular and instructional issues, as well as basic troubleshooting in a virtual classroom environment that is in line with academy policies and procedures

  • Travels as required (on average once per month and/or approximately 20% of the time) for face-to-face professional development, student testing, and as required by school

REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree AND

  • Active state teaching license AND

  • Ability to clear required background check

DESIRED QUALIFICATION:

  • Experience working with proposed age group.

  • Experience supporting adults and children in the use of technology.

  • Experience teaching in an online (virtual) and/or in a brick-and-mortar environment.

  • Experience with online learning platforms.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with other teachers to interpret and produce numeric, tabular, and graphic representations of student data, and use it to drive instructional decisions.

  • Receptive to receiving coaching regularly with administrators and teacher trainers.

  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint.

  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms.

  • Ability to maintain teacher certification/professional development hours and fluency in K12 systems, programs and curriculum.

Compensation & Benefits: Stride, Inc. considers a person’s education, experience, and qualifications, as well as the position’s work location, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value when determining a new employee’s salary level. Salaries will differ based on these factors, the position’s level and expected contribution, and the employee’s benefits elections. Offers will typically be in the bottom half of the range.

  • We anticipate the salary range to be $55,000 - $75,000. This salary is not guaranteed, as an individual’s compensation can vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to, geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions. Stride offers a robust benefits package for eligible employees that can include health benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • This position is virtual.

Job Type

Regular

All employment is “at-will” as governed by the law of the state where the employee works. raw.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong's IT team is standing up a new capability: a small, specialized group that goes directly into business functions and builds AI into how work gets done. We call them AI Enablement Specialists — and we're looking for a senior practitioner to help lead that effort.

This isn't an advisory role. You'll be hands-on with the teams you support, building tools that solve real problems and helping people develop new skills they'll carry forward. The scope is company-wide — Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, Customer Success, and beyond. You'll have the autonomy to prioritize where your time creates the most value, and the backing of IT leadership to get things done.

If you've already done this kind of work — transforming how people and teams operate through AI — and you're looking for an environment where you can do it at scale with real ownership, this is the role.

What You'll Do:

  • Spend time inside business teams to understand how they actually work — their tools, processes, pain points, and highest-priority outputs.

  • Build AI-powered workflows, automations, and custom tools that address real bottlenecks and deliver measurable time savings.

  • Help team members develop their own AI skills through one-on-one coaching, working sessions, and structured practice — moving them from early experimentation to confident, independent use.

  • Recognize when a solution built for one team applies to others, and do the work to make it reusable across the organization.

  • Establish a clear framework for tracking AI adoption progress across business units and report findings to IT leadership on a regular cadence.

  • Set documentation standards for the team — every tool, workflow, and lesson learned should be captured so it doesn't live only in your head.

  • Help develop Kong's internal AI governance standards in partnership with IT, Security, and Engineering.

  • Mentor junior team members and interns, giving them hands-on experience and clear feedback.

  • Stay current on AI developments and translate what's relevant into practical applications for Kong's business context.

What You'll Bring:

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical or cross-functional role that required problem-solving across teams and functions.

  • A track record of building AI-powered tools, automations, or workflows that changed how real work gets done — with specific examples you can speak to.

  • Experience helping others develop new technical skills, whether through formal training, one-on-one coaching, or team enablement programs.

  • Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain a technical concept to someone who's never thought about it before, without talking down to them.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-direction; you don't need a detailed roadmap to know where to start.

  • Experience working in or with an IT organization, or a comparable role supporting business operations across multiple functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with AI development platforms and tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, LLM APIs, custom agent frameworks, or workflow automation platforms.

  • Background in change management, organizational development, or a large-scale rollout that required bringing skeptical stakeholders along.

  • Experience in consulting, solutions engineering, or a client-facing technical role where you had to earn trust and deliver results quickly.

  • Familiarity with the enterprise SaaS tools Kong runs on: Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Jira, or Freshservice.

  • Experience creating internal toolkits, playbooks, or training programs that outlived your involvement and were adopted at scale.

  • Familiarity with Kong Konnect, Kong Gateway, or API management concepts — understanding how APIs and AI models connect will help you build smarter tools.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., a leading developer of API and AI connectivity technologies, is building the infrastructure that powers the agentic era. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform, Kong Konnect, enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI models. For more information, visit .

Compensation Range: $94,150 - $135,000

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP)
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$125,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Consultant (ABAP) with strong S/4HANA expertise to design, develop, and support custom enhancements, integrations, and reports within large enterprise SAP landscapes. This role spans the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, hands-on coding, unit testing, performance tuning, and post-go-live support in close collaboration with functional consultants and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will combine deep ABAP expertise — including core ABAP, ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and OData — with a strong understanding of S/4HANA architecture, Fiori integration, and clean-core principles that minimize technical debt and ease future upgrades.

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of professional ABAP development experience, with significant time on S/4HANA.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with ABAP OO, CDS views, AMDPs, and HANA-optimized ABAP.
  • Solid experience building OData services and integrating with Fiori applications.
  • Hands-on experience with enhancement frameworks (BADIs, user exits, implicit/explicit enhancements).
  • Strong experience with integration technologies (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, Web Services).
  • Solid understanding of SAP module data structures, including FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP, depending on the project area.
  • Experience with performance tuning tools (SAT, ST05) and HANA diagnostic tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, and SAP transport management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with S/4HANA system conversions or greenfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP BTP, ABAP RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), or steampunk.
  • Hands-on experience with Fiori/UI5 development.
  • Familiarity with SAP CPI / Integration Suite.
  • SAP-certified ABAP developer credentials.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for GitLab's Portfolio Experience team. You'll be an experienced product engineer who incorporates user needs into feature decisions and brings full stack experience, with a current focus on backend. You'll spend as much time understanding user needs and shaping how features should work as you do building them, working directly with product, users, and open source contributors.

You'll help evolve the backend architecture that powers the work items platform, which must serve millions of work items in a single user's view across tens of thousands of groups and projects.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with product and other engineers to shape requirements, understand user needs, and break complex projects into shippable iterations.
  • Design and implement backend and real-time features in the GitLab monolith, including GraphQL and RESTful APIs and subscriptions, with a focus on performance, reliability, and user impact.
  • Build and evolve portfolio planning capabilities, including work item hierarchy, status rollup, and capacity planning.
  • Improve PostgreSQL performance at scale through query and write optimization, indexing, denormalization, partitioning, and moving suitable workloads to Elasticsearch or ClickHouse.
  • Create proofs of concept for complex work, maintain extensive automated test coverage, and support safe rollouts with feature flags and strong observability.
  • Mentor engineers and open source contributors through code reviews, pairing, regular feedback, contributor issues, and hackathons.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve the team's development and review processes.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience representing the user perspective while working through trade-offs with product managers, engineers, and users.
  • Experience leading projects involving several engineers over multiple months and supporting others through thoughtful code reviews, feedback, hiring, career development, and mentoring.
  • Full stack experience with a current backend focus, including proficiency with Ruby and Ruby on Rails and an understanding of how complex modern frontends work.
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills and experience improving database performance at scale through query and write optimization, indexing, denormalization, and partitioning.
  • Experience designing and evolving GraphQL and/or RESTful APIs with attention to scalability, backward compatibility, and clear contracts with frontend clients.
  • Experience improving large automated test suites, including the performance and reliability of the tests themselves.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for an asynchronous, distributed environment.
  • Experience integrating artificial intelligence into development workflows. Experience building artificial intelligence-powered features or working with Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, or Python is a plus.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable skills. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

We are a team of 4 - 2x Backend Engineers, 2x Frontend Engineers located across Europe and Canada. We own the work item hierarchy, including Epic, Issue, and Task relationships, and top-down planning capabilities such as status rollup and capacity planning. We work async-first in two-week iterations, with retrospectives and a weekly sync.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. raw.description:
We are looking for a skilled and creative architect to join our design team within the real estate development business, focusing on boutique hospitality assets.

In this role, you will be responsible for conducting design research, assembling various architectural ideas, and developing sketches, designs, and drawings at different RIBA stages. You should be able to work independently throughout the day, coordinate with the team when needed, and deliver intermediate results weekly. You will report to a project architect (lead) but collaborate with the entire design team, including but not limited to interior designers, CGI artists, the MEP team, structural engineers, the FF&E procurement team, and client representatives.

This role will work more with early design stages. Personal engagement in RIBA 1-3 will be around 75%, RIBA 4-5 supervision and advisory - up to 25%.

Location & Collaboration Format

  • This is a fully remote job.
  • We collaborate in Сentral European time zone (CET) or UK hours.
  • Utopia does not provide visa sponsorship and/or relocation package for this position.

Responsibilities

  • Work on a variety of high-end hospitality projects as a design architect
  • Conduct feasibility studies, volumetric proposals, area calculations, and land plot analyses as part of the pre-design stage of projects
  • Interpret the design brief and collaborate with client representatives to achieve the best results
  • Perform design research and create presentations, mood boards, and reference materials
  • Generate architectural ideas and sketches, and conduct research on references and mood boards
  • Execute concept design development, including but not limited to detailed massing proposals and volumetric studies. Develop architectural layouts, optimize ergonomics and circulation, and balance aesthetics, function, and operational aspects. Focus on enhancing the expressiveness of volumetric architectural forms, facades, and free-form designs
  • Develop volumetric studies into concept layouts, Revit (RVT) models, and foundational inputs for the CGI team
  • Refine concept layouts through the schematic and detailed design stages
  • Collaborate closely with in-house structural and MEP teams, as well as the local Architect of Record (AOR), to achieve optimal concept adaptation and spatial coordination, while carefully preserving the initial design intent
  • Support the FF&E procurement team with quantity calculations, material research, and detailing
  • Stay up to date with modern trends in the high-end hospitality industry. Research new technologies, materials, and methodologies; conduct investigations and propose innovative solutions
  • Mentor junior team members, supervise work performed by BIM modelers, and elevate the design department's storytelling and presentation skills

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Architecture
  • 7 to 10 years of experience in architectural design
  • Experience working on low-rise residential and hospitality projects - private homes and villas, hotels and resorts
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp, or other sketch-oriented presentation software like Rhino, Lumion, or Enscape
  • Advanced/Fluent level of English, both written and verbal
  • Portfolio is a must

Benefits

  • Work on projects from concept to realization: contribute across the full architectural journey, from early vision and planning to execution and operational experience.
  • Design with long-term impact: create spaces intended to become globally recognized hospitality destinations.
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: work closely with interiors, landscape, construction, operations, and guest experience teams from the earliest stages.
  • Creative influence from the ground up: contribute ideas before projects are locked into rigid systems or external frameworks.
  • Global architectural exposure: work on location-specific projects influenced by diverse cultural, environmental, and hospitality contexts.
  • High design standards: join a team deeply focused on detail, materiality, atmosphere, and timeless hospitality design.
  • End-to-end development insight: gain exposure not only to design, but also to execution, operations, and the realities of luxury hospitality development.
  • Exposure to luxury standards and materials: work with elevated design references, premium finishes, and globally inspired concepts.
  • Influence guest experience through design: contribute to how spaces function emotionally as well as aesthetically.

Two Opportunities!

We have two Team Lead openings — one in Property Claims and one in General Liability. The shared responsibilities, qualifications, and expectations are outlined below. Role-specific details for each position are at the bottom of this posting. When you apply, please indicate which role you are interested in.

Opening 1 – Ryze

Property Claims Team Lead

Opening 2 - Certus

General Liability Claims Team Lead

About the Role

Both Team Lead openings are working lead roles — you carry an active claim portfolio while providing day-to-day guidance, oversight, and mentorship to the team around you. You are the first point of escalation for complex coverage and claim handling questions, and a direct extension of Claims Manager and Director-level leadership.

The right person for either role is a seasoned adjuster who is ready to take on real leadership responsibility without stepping away from the work. If you have been the person your teammates come to when things get complicated, this is your next step.

What You'll Do

Claim Handling

  • Manage an active portfolio of claims from report to resolution, consistent with client guidelines and company direction.
  • Examine policies and records to determine coverage and document positions clearly.
  • Conduct thorough investigations per claim handling guidelines and best practices.
  • Estimate costs, prepare reports of findings, and negotiate settlements.
  • Respond to all communications — emails, voicemails, client forms — within required timeframes.
  • Assist with escalations and reassignments across the team as directed.

Team Leadership and Coaching

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for team members on complex coverage, liability, and negotiation questions.
  • Review team work product for quality, accuracy, and consistency with client and company standards.
  • Provide day-to-day mentorship and coaching to adjusters on your team.
  • Identify skill gaps and partner with management and training to address them.
  • Support onboarding of new team members through file reviews and real-time guidance.
  • Monitor workloads and flag capacity or quality concerns to management proactively.
  • Model the standards of professionalism, production, and client service expected across the team.

Reporting and Communication

  • Provide ongoing feedback to management on team performance, file status, and emerging issues.
  • Assist management with client reporting and communication as needed.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement at the process and procedure level.

What We're Looking For

Required for both roles:

  • Active adjuster license in applicable states.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including policy interpretation.
  • Sound decision-making and ability to work independently.
  • Analytical and proactive approach to claim handling.
  • Proficient in MS Office: Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading other adjusters.

Preferred for both roles:

  • Prior formal lead, senior, or supervisory experience in a claims environment.
  • Previous TPA experience strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with multi-carrier environments and varying client guidelines.
  • Ability to speak Spanish a plus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Your own portfolio closes on time and meets quality standards consistently.
  • Team members have a reliable resource for hard questions and leave those conversations with a clear path forward.
  • Escalations to management are well-framed, documented, and come with a recommendation.
  • Adjusters on your team improve measurably under your guidance.
